47
ተመአሬ መጠአፌ
 6። ጊንጥጦ
ሼምፕፖ ኡሱፕፑነ
ቆፕፖበተ፦ ተመአሬቲ ሀ ሼምፕፑወ ዉርስሴꬃን፦
 " ጊንጥጦ አይበቴꬃ ሀይዚዲ ቀአለን ሺኢሻነ።
 " ዱምመ ዱምመ ኦዶተ ጊንጥጦ ጊድዶፕፔ ሻአክከነ።
 " ኦዶተ ጊንጥጦ ጠአፊሼ ጎዔትተነ።
 " ጊንጥጦን ቀአለ ጎዔቴꬃረ ሜእዜተነ።
ዴንꬄꬆ ኦይሾተ
1። ጊንጥጦይ አይቤእ ?
2። ጊንጥጦይ ሀረ ቢለ ጡኡፌተፕፔ አይቢን ዱምመቲኢ ?
3። ጊንጥጦ የረተ እሬእቲኢ ?
4። ኢስሲ ጊንጥጠንችቻ ጎኦበ ጊንጥጠንችቾ ኡዲየ በተ ቆንጭጪሲቴ።
ጊንጥጦ አይበቴꬃ
ጊንጥጦይ ቆሬትቲደ ቀአለን ደልግገ ቆፊ ቀንꬃረ መልዕዖ ሀኖተን ሺኢቂየ ቢለ ጡኡፌ።
ጊንጥጦይ እእዶይ ዴዒየ፣ አሰ ከሀ ዴንꬄꬆሲንኔ ከሀ ዉቴꬃ ጊተ ዎልቅቂ ዴዒየ 
ሂኢልለ ኦኦሶ። ጊንጥጦይ ቤኒ ጡኡፌይ ዶኦሜትቶንነ ዎዴን ሰበን ቀንꬃረ ሺኢቂሼ 
ገምዕዒስ። ሄስሰፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰን ጊንጥጦይ ጬእገ ቢለ ጡኡፌ፤ ሜꬎይክከ ቀንꬂንኔ 
ሲቂሜትቲደበ።
ደሮ እረንችቻቲ ኦዲየ ሜለ ጊንጥጦይ ቀንꬃን ሺኢቀነ ሜለ ኦኦꬂደ ገአሶቲ ዘአሪ 
ቆፎስ ኢንጅጄተነ ሜለንኔ ቀአለን ኦይክከነው ወአዪሶንነ ሜለስሰ። ኑ እሪየ ሜለ 
ጡኡፌን ጊዲን ሀአሰየን ኡሰ አዱስሴንኔ ዦርዱሞርድደ ጊዲደ አልለልሌይ ሀይዘንቻተስ 
ከሀ ዉትቴንነ፣ ሀይዘነውክከ ሱኡኬዬንነ።
ጊንጥጦይ አደርስሰንችቻ ከሀፕፔ እእሶን ፑልትቴእስ። ጉጀንክከ ገአነው ቆፕፒደበአ 
እልሌሲሼ ጊዲ ፖሊ አግጌእሲፕፔ አትቲን ኦደአ አዱስሲሼንኔ ጎኦቺሼ ፔቶ ፔእዔንነ። 
″ኦዲ ደሪን ሀሬን ጨአኔትቴንነ″ ጊየ ቆፈ ሜለ ጊንጥጦን ሀይዘንችቺ ኢኢሻነ ገሶ 
ጎኦሼቺየበይ በአወ።

ሼምፕፖ 6፦ ጊንጥጦ ሼምፕፖ 6፦ጊንጥጦ
48
9ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ
ኢስሲ ሎዕዖ ጊንጥጦይ ሺኢቂየ ዴꬃን ጊንጥጡወ መልዑኡወፕፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰን 
ሀይዘንቻቲ ፐንትተ ሀይꬃ ዬግጊዲ አይፊየ ቂፆንነንኔ ኡትቲደ ቤስሰፕፔ ቀአጥጦንነ 
ዴዒየ ቤስሰ ዶገነአ ገሶ ዉደ ዎꬂዲ ከአልሎሶነ።
ጊንጥጦይ ደሮ ዎዴ ሺኢቄይ ዴꬃን ጊዲን ዱምመ ዲዲርጥጠተ ገአሶ ኡዲዲ ዬꬃን፣ 
ዜሌልስሰን፣ ጬእቆን፣ ሰበኒንኔ ህ።ህ።ም ሀኖተተን ዱምመ ዱምመ ቆፕፖበተ ጩኡጩምሚዲ 
አአꬍꬌእስ።
ጊንጥጦ የረተ
ጊንጥጦስ ዱምመ ዱምመ የረቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። ሄስሰቲክከ፦
አ። ኬሶ
ብ። ቱረ
ጭ። ዚረ
ድ። ኩሬ
እ። ሚጤንኔ ሾቼ
ፍ። እእዶ
ግ። ፖሎ
ህ። ዲንጥጦ 
አ። ኬሶ፦ ጊንጥጦ የፈረን ኡትቲደ ቀአለተስ ኢስሲ ሼምፕፖን ጤእሴትቲየ ኮኦሼተ 
ቤስሲየ ቆፈ። ደሮ ዎዴ ኬሶተ ኡስትተተ በአሶ ኡዲዲ ሻአክኮኦስ።
መልለ፦ ከሬእꬃ መለአ፣ ኬንቼቻ ቴእመአ፣
ሀ ኢስሲ የፈረ ጊንጥጡወአን ኬሶይ የአኒ ኡትቴእስ፦
/ከ – ሬእ – ꬃ/ /መ – ለአ/ /ኬን - ቼ – ቻ/ /ቴእ - መአ/
ብ። ቱረ፦ ቱሪ ጊንጥጦስ ኢስሲ የፈረስ (ዚረስ) በግገ።
መልለ፦ ከሬእꬃ መለአ ኬንቼቻ ቴእመ
ከሬእꬃ መለ = ኮይሮ ቱረ
ኬንቼቻ ቴእመ = ነምዕዓንꬆ ቱረ
ጭ። ዚረ፦ ዚሪ ጊንጥጦስ ኢስሲ የፈረ።
መልለ፦ ከሬእꬃ መለአ ኬንቼቻ ቴእመ፣
ሀ ቆፈይ ጊንጥጦስ ኢስሲ ዚረ ገአነው ደንደዔትቴእስ።
ድ። ኩሬ፦ ኩሬይ ዚረተ ሺኢቆ ጊዲዲ ፐ ጊድዶን ኢስሲ አይፌ ቆፈ ኦይክኪየ ጊንጥጦስ 
ሜንꬆ ገአነው ደንደዖኦስ።
መልለ፦ ቲሚርትቲየአን ሚንኒዲ ሰሎረ ፐአልለነአ፣
ፒኢልግጊ ጠንነዒዲ ሻአክኪዲ ፒንነነአ፣
ኦይቺዲ ቂኢጨነ ꬎቅቀ ሶኦ ገክከነአ።

ሼምፕፖ 6፦ጊንጥጦ
49
ተመአሬ መጠአፌ
ሀ ቆምሞን ሺኢቂደ ጊንጥጦ የፈረቲ ኢስሲ አይፌ ቆፈ ቶኦክኪደ ኢስሲ ኩሬ ገአነው 
ደንድደዔትቴእስ።
እ። ሚጤንኔ እእዶ፦ ሚጤ ጊሺን ኢስሲ ጊንጥጦ ቱረን ዎይ ዚረን ዴዒየ ኬሶተ 
ፐይዶይ ጊነ ጊዴይስሰ ቲልለዬꬃ ኦጌ። እእዶይ ቀስሲ ዚረተ ዉርስሴꬃን ቤእትቲየ 
ቀአለተ ዎይ ኮኦሼተ ገአሶን ነብበቢሺን ሲዔትቲየ ዬꬃአደ ሀኒየ መልዕዖ 
ኮኦሼ።
መልለ፦ ቲሚርትቲየን ሚንኒዲ ሰሎረ ፐአልለነአ
/ቲ-ሚርት-ቲየን ሚን-ኒ-ዲ/ /ሰ-ሎ-ረ ፐአል-ለ-ነ/
ሀ ጊንጥጦ የፈረአ ሚጢየ ጤእልሊሺን 6/6 ኬሶን ሚጤትቴእስ።
ፍ። ፖሎ፦ ጊንጥጦ ዚረተስ ዉርስሴꬃን ቤእትቲየ ሚሰቲየ ኮኦሼተ ዎይ ፒደሌተ 
ጉኡስሲ።
ግ። ዲንጥጦን፦ ኢስሲ ኩሬን ሺኢቂየ ዚረቲ ፐንትተ ሲመ ቆፈ ኢስሲ ሜለ ፒደሌን ዎይ 
ኮኦሼን ፖሊሺን ዲንጥጦ ጌእቴትቴእስ።
ሜእዜ ኢስሶ
 6።1። ሀይዞ
ኢ። ሀይሰፕፔ ገርስሰን ሺኢቂደ ጊንጥጡወ ሂንትቴ አስትተመአሬይ ነብበቢሺን 
አኬእኪሼ ዎገዪ ሀይዚዲ ከአልሊ ሺኢቂደ ሜእዜተ ኦኦꬂቴ።
ዱኡቅቆፐ
ጠነዕዓፕፔ አትቲን አሰበ ዱኡቅቆፐ፣
አሰበ ዉትተደ ዎንትቶ ዬእልለቶፕፐ፣
 ሻአክኮንነ ሰልዕዓደ ጮኦበአስ ጦኦኔትቶፕፐ፣
 ኔነን አምመኔትተ ሀረተን ከቶፕፐ።
 ጢነአቲየአን ቤእትቲደ እረይ ጌእድደሬትቴእስ፣
 አወኒክከ ጊዲን ፖሎይ ሲንꬄ ኬዬእስ፣
 ጨወትቲ ዴምሚደይ እግጌቶንነ ከንꬄእስ፣
 ዱኡቅቂዲ ሺሺደይ ኢስሶኦዴ ዬእልለቴእስ።
 ዱኡቆን አምመኔቴእ ተመአሬይ እሬትቴእስ፣
 ኪፊሌን ኡትቲዲ ከሬ ከሬ ጤእልሌእስ፣

ሼምፕፖ 6፦ ጊንጥጦ ሼምፕፖ 6፦ጊንጥጦ
50
9ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ
 ተመአረነው ዪሼ ዎዲየ አአꬂ ገክኬእስ፣
 ፐአጬይ መቲ ኪቺን ዱኡቆስ ሲንꬄ ሜእጭጬእስ።
 ዱኡቆይ ሀድዲሪክኮ ዬግጊዲ ሶኦ ሲምሜእስ፣
 ሚንኒዲ ጎዬንነ ቦኔ አወስ በብቤስ፣
 በልግጎይ የአዴ ቀስሲ ኢረ ዴሾስ ሂርግጌእስ፣
 ዎንትቶስ ሀልቾንነሺን ነይተ ዘተ ዬሌእስ፣
 ነይቲ ከꬂ ኦይቺን ሁኡጴ ቀአቺ ደሬእስ።
ዱኡቅቂዲ ገክኪደ አኪሜይ ሀግገዚን፣
ቦልለረ ቦሼቼእስ ኡሎ ጊድዶን ሰክኪን፣
ጊድዶን ኦኦሊሶ በአስ ሁኡጴ ꬋሌ ኢምሚን፣
ሀርግጊሲዲ ዘአሬእስ ፐሽክከቴꬃ ኮዪን።
ጢነአቲየን ገክኪደ አኪሜይ እሬትቴእስ፣
 መተ ሶኦን ሀአሆ ሶኦን ኢየ ኦኦሶይ ነሼትቴእስ፣
ሱንꬃይ ኡብበ ቤስሰን ጤእጊሺን ቴእመቴእስ፣
ነርፕፔ ጨድዲን አግጊን ዞሬን ፐꬂ ዬድዴእስ፣
 ሀግገአዘአን ፐለሂ ከዎንክከ ዎይቴትቴእስ።
ዱኡቅቂ አንጅጄቲደይ አአወቴእስ ሱንꬄቴእስ፣
ቱመ ፒርድደ አግጊ ፐክኮ ፐአክኮ ደፌእስ፣
አምመኑወ ደብቦተ ሀረ አይፌን ጤእልሌእስ፣
ፐ ኡሎ ኩንꬂደአ ዎኦዘነፕፔ ዶሴእስ፣
ዎገነው ኡትቲቲ ሀረ ሜቶ ሜꬌእእስ።
ሚንኒ ጠነዒደይ አረአተ ዴምመነአ፣
አይሶ ሶኦ ገክኪክኮ ኡብበተ አልለነአ፣
ዎብበአቶ ቢልሊዲ ዎጊዲ ከንꬃነ፣
ኦኦꬂክኮ ኦዲክኮ ዉሪ አሚንዕዓነአ
ሀግገአዘአን አሊዲ አንጅጂሼ ሲምመነአ።
 (ጊንጥጦ፦ ግ።ዪርደው ንኔ ግ። ኢሲየአስ)

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Ginxxoy qorettida qaalan dalgga qofi qanthara mal77o hanotan shiiqiya bila xuufe.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ጊንጥጦይ ቆሬትቲደ ቀአለን ደልግገ ቆፊ ቀንꬃረ መልዕዖ ሀኖተን ሺኢቂየ ቢለ ጡኡፌ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: ግጥም በተመረጡ ቃላት ሰፊ ሐሳብ በአጭሩና በጣፋጭ ሁኔታ የሚቀርብበት የሥነ-ጽሑፍ ዘውግ ነው።
key_aligned_sentences.english: Poetry (Ginxxo) is a literary art form in which expansive ideas are presented concisely and melodiously through carefully chosen words.

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Duuqqopa (Kure 1): 'Xana77appe attin asaba duuqqopa, / Asaba wuttada wontto yeellatoppa, / Shaakkonna sal77ada coobaas xoonettoppa, / Nenan ammanetta haratan katoppa.'
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ዱኡቅቆፐ (ኩሬ 1)፦ 'ጠነዕዓፕፔ አትቲን አሰበ ዱኡቅቆፐ፣ / አሰበ ዉትተደ ዎንትቶ ዬእልለቶፕፐ፣ / ሻአክኮንነ ሰልዕዓደ ጮኦበአስ ጦኦኔትቶፕፐ፣ / ኔነን አምመኔትተ ሀረተን ከቶፕፐ።'
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: 'አትኮርጅ' (አንጓ 1)፦ 'ከማጥናት በቀር የሰው አትኮርጅ፣ / የሰው ገልብጠህ ነገ አትፈር፣ / ሳትለይ አግበስብሰህ ለከንቱ ነገር አትሸነፍ፣ / በራስህ ተማመን በሌሎች አትደገፍ።'
key_aligned_sentences.english: 'Do Not Cheat' (Stanza 1): 'Study diligently rather than copying others' work; do not copy others and bring shame upon yourself tomorrow; believe in yourself and do not lean on others.'

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Duuqqopa (Kure 8): 'Minni xana7iday araata demmanaa, / Ayso soo gakkikko ubbata allanaa, / Wobbaato billidi wogidi kanthana, / Oothikko odikko wuri amin77anaa, / Haggaazaan alidi anjjishe simmanaa.'
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ዱኡቅቆፐ (ኩሬ 8)፦ 'ሚንኒ ጠነዒደይ አረአተ ዴምመነአ፣ / አይሶ ሶኦ ገክኪክኮ ኡብበተ አልለነአ፣ / ዎብበአቶ ቢልሊዲ ዎጊዲ ከንꬃነ፣ / ኦኦꬂክኮ ኦዲክኮ ዉሪ አሚንዕዓነአ፣ / ሀግገአዘአን አሊዲ አንጅጂሼ ሲምመነአ።'
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: 'አትኮርጅ' (አንጓ 8)፦ 'ጠንክሮ ያጠና ክብር (ዙፋን) ያገኛል፣ / በአመራር ቦታ ሲደርስ ሁሉንም ያስደስታል፣ / የተጣመመውን አቃንቶ በሕግ ያሻግራል፣ / በአገልግሎቱ ከብሮ እየተመረቀ ይመለሳል።'
key_aligned_sentences.english: 'Do Not Cheat' (Stanza 8): 'One who studies diligently attains honor; when reaching leadership, they serve all fairly, resolve disputes justly, and earn the community's blessing.'

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (6.2 Haasaya, p. 55): 'Duuqqopa' giya ginxxuwa eedo naagidi kifile tamaaretas nabbabite; duuqoy (exam cheating) tamaare bolla, aakime bolla, nne daanna bolla gathiya qohota tobbite.
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (6።2 ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 55)፦ 'ዱኡቅቆፐ' ጊየ ጊንጥጡወ እእዶ ነአጊዲ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬተስ ነብበቢቴ፤ ዱኡቆይ (እጠም ቼአቲንግ) ተመአሬ ቦልለ፣ አአኪሜ ቦልለ፣ ንኔ ደአንነ ቦልለ ገꬂየ ቆሆተ ቶብቢቴ።
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (6.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 55)፦ 'Duuqqopa' (አትኮርጅ) የሚለውን ግጥም ዜማውን ጠብቃችሁ አንብቡ፤ ኩረጃ በተማሪ፣ በሐኪምና በዳኛ ላይ የሚያስከትለውን ጉዳት ተወያዩ።

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Ginxxo Yarata & 6/6 Metrical Scansion (pp. 52–53): Malla: 'Timirttiyan minnidi / salora paallanaa' -> Scanned as /Ti-mirt-tiyan min-ni-di/ (6 keso) + /sa-lo-ra paal-la-na/ (6 keso) = 6/6 metrical line (Zira) composed of two 6-syllable hemistichs (Tura).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ጊንጥጦ የረተ & 6/6 ሜትሪጨል ስጨንሲኦን (ፕፕ። 52–53)፦ መልለ፦ 'ቲሚርትቲየን ሚንኒዲ / ሰሎረ ፐአልለነአ' -> ስጨንኔድ አስ /ቲ-ሚርት-ቲየን ሚን-ኒ-ዲ/ (6 ኬሶ) + /ሰ-ሎ-ረ ፐአል-ለ-ነ/ (6 ኬሶ) = 6/6 ሜትሪጨል ሊኔ (ዚረ) ጮምፖሴድ ኦፍ ትዎ 6-ስይልለብሌ ሄሚስቲችስ (ቱረ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: የግጥም ምጣኔና አወቃቀር (ገጽ 52–53)፦ ምሳሌ፦ '/Ti-mirt-tiyan min-ni-di/ (6 ቀለም) + /sa-lo-ra paal-la-na/ (6 ቀለም)' = በ6/6 ቀለም የተመጠነ ስንኝ (Zira)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Poetic Meter and Scansion (pp. 52–53): Demonstrates 6/6 syllabic meter (Mixe) dividing a 12-syllable line (Zira) into two 6-syllable hemistichs (Tura).

meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ሄእꬓ (6።3 ነብበቦ፣ ፕፕ። 55–56)፦ 1። ሀ ጊንጥጡወአስ ('ዱኡቅቆፐ') አአፕፑን ኩሬይ ዴዒኢ? -> ዘአሮ፦ 8 ኩሬ (8 ስተንዘስ)። 3። ጊንጥጦይ አአፕፑን ኬሶን ሚጤትቲዴእ? -> ዘአሮ፦ 6/6 (12) ኬሶን ሚጤትቲስ።
meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 3 (ምንባብ፣ ገጽ 55–56)፦ 1. 'Duuqqopa' ግጥም ስንት አንጓ (kure) አለው? -> መልስ፦ 8 አንጓ። 3. በስንት ቀለም (keso) ተመጠነ? -> መልስ፦ 6/6 ቀለም።
meeze_student_exercises.english: Exercise 3 (Poem Analysis, pp. 55–56): 1. How many stanzas (kure) does 'Duuqqopa' have? -> 8 stanzas. 3. What is its syllabic meter (mixe)? -> 6/6 syllables.

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Koroona vayrese hargge (KOVIDE-19) malaatata, gathiya qohotanne teqetha ogeta akeekana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ኮሮኦነ ቨይሬሴ ሀርግጌ (ኮቪዴ-19) መለአተተ፣ ገꬂየ ቆሆተንኔ ቴቄꬃ ኦጌተ አኬእከነ።

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Goofatho doona xaafo hiillatanne pidaleta qaala giddon wogara xaafo maara (Ustta = U, Guttuma = G) nne dhanthetetha (affixation) shaakkana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ጠአፎ ሂኢልለተንኔ ፒደሌተ ቀአለ ጊድዶን ዎገረ ጠአፎ መአረ (ኡስትተ = ኡ፣ ጉትቱመ = ግ) ንኔ ꬋንꬄቴꬃ (አፍፊጠቲኦን) ሻአክከነ።

nabbabo_reading_passages.full_passage_gofatho_latin:
Shemppo 7:Kovide-19 Kooroona Vayresse Hargge
55
Tamaare Maxaafe
 7.1.  Hayzo
I. Hessappe Kaallidi Hentte Asttamaarey Nibaabiya Nabbabishin Hayzidi Daassa 
Giddon De7iya Pace Bessata Kunthite. He Qaalata Xaafishe Pidale Balaa 
naagettite.
Hargge
Asa na7i wodetan wodetan daro (1) ------------- nne (2) --------- gaason medhettiya 
harggeti de7oosona. Ha harggeta (3) --------- bertte qommotan shaakkidi xeellanaw 
dandda7ettees. Hessatikka gade giddo hargge nne (4) ----- hargge gaanaw 
dandda7ettees. Gade giddo harggeti dhuussaynne denddoy issi heeran woy gaden 
gididi asa shemppo miyaanne qoha gathiya gidishin, kumetha alame detha gado 
harggeti alame gadetappe issuwan dhuuqqidi hara alame gadetakko (5) ---------- 
hargge. Ha haathe pinnidi dharccettiya harggeti dumma dumma gadeti medhdhiya 
tiranispportte qaaxotan issuwaappe haraakko eeson aadhdhees. Hessa mela kanddoy 
de7iya harggetappe (6) ------------ harggey sintha besse oykkees. 
I. Qommon Hintte Asttamaarey Shiishida Hayzo Miishiya Akeekan Hayzishe 
Ayfe Qofata Hintte Dawtariyaan Xaafidi Hayzidayssa Kuuyite. 
II. Haysappe Garssan Shiiqida Nibaabiyaappe Zaaro Demmana Gidi Qoppiya 
Heedzu Oyshata Xaafidi Hintte Asttamaariya Bessite.
KOROONA VAYRESE HARGGE (KOVIDE-19)
Koroona vayrese hargge (KOVIDE-19) geetettidi erettiya vayrese harggey kare 
gade laytha qoodaan 2019 wurssethan Chayna Yohan kataman koyro wode beettida 
gado hargge gidishin he harggey asappe asan aadhdhiya, hargganchata bolla bessiya 
malaati de7iya, asa bolla gita qohata gathiya, issi issi asatan bala xeeloti imettiyaanne 
teqqanaw dandda7ettiya hargge.
Koroona vayrese harggey asappe asakko eeson aadhdhiya ogeti de7osona. He 
aadhetha ogetappe hargganchchappe qufishin, hadhdhishishin woy shemppishin 
keyiya peenuwa gaason, hargganchchappe keyiya laakkiyaaba bochida kushiya 
boshoninne qoomettidi saroson, hargganchchata miishata kothen go7etethan 
aadhees. Gujjanakka, harganchati dumma dumma bessatan bochchidi woy go7ettidi 
aadhdhida miisheta eeson bochchishininne assay dariya bessatan walakettidi allalleta 
polishin ha harggey hargganchchappe paxa asakko dharccettees.

Shemppo 7: Kovide-19 Kooroona Vayresse Hargge Shemppo 7:Kovide-19 Kooroona Vayresse Hargge
56
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Koroona vayrese harggey oykkida asa bolla daro malaatati beettoosona. Ha 
malaatatappe bertteta be7ishin, ha harggey oykkida asa bolla gita qoxonne misha, 
shemppanaw un77etho, mela zode qufenne qoodhe giddo saho malaatati beettoosona. 
Qassikka he harggey minni minni bishe goofina bochchidi kilahoy oothonna mela 
udiya hargge.
KOVIDE-19 koroona vayrese harggey alame dethan asa na7a shemppo, 
ikkonoomenne issipetetha duussa bolla gita qoha gathida hargge. Ha harggey asa 
na7a shemppo bolla qoha gathis gishin, harggiya teqqanaw butetiya akimetanne 
dokttooreta shemppo mis, wontto gades maaddana yalaga nayta wodhis, zoridi 
zaariya donzata shemppokka dhayssis. Hessa kanchche gidonnashin asa kochche 
qorenna. Oykkikko ubba harggisees nne wodhanaw dandda7ees. Ikkonoome 
baggara qassi turuuzumeppe,zal7eppe, tiranispportteppenne hara eqotatappe kawos

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 1. Goofatho Doona Xaafo Hiillatanne Pidaleta Qaala Giddon Wogara Xaafo Maara (6 Core Orthographic Rules & Zara 5 CV Table, pp. 63–65): Ustta = U (vowel), Guttuma = G (consonant). Rules: (1) Two different vowels (usttati) never cluster at word onset; (2) Consonants (guttumati) never geminate at word onset (*GGUG is illegal); (3) When two different vowels meet word-medially, glottal stop '7' (gilootaley) is inserted (e.g., sa7a, na7a, ma7o); (4) Doubled consonants medial-internally are pronounced geminated (minni nabbabettoosona); (5) Doubled vowels are pronounced long (aduqqi nabbabettoosona); (6) Digraph consonants (waatha guttumati: ch, dh, dz, ny, ph, sh, th, zh) represent a single phoneme. Zara 5 patterns: U (i, ee), GU (ba, ta, ne), GUGU (mata, kathi, qofa), GUGUGGU (timirtte, atarqqa), UGGUGUGU (asttamaare), GUGUU (nam77a, gam77a).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 1። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ጠአፎ ሂኢልለተንኔ ፒደሌተ ቀአለ ጊድዶን ዎገረ ጠአፎ መአረ (6 ጮሬ ኦርꬆግረጪጭ ሩሌስ & ዘረ 5 ጭቭ ተብሌ፣ ፕፕ። 63–65)፦ ኡስትተ = ኡ (ቮዌል)፣ ጉትቱመ = ግ (ጮንሶነንት)። ሩሌስ፦ (1) ትዎ ዲፍፌሬንት ቮዌልስ (ኡስትተቲ) ኔቬር ጭሉስቴር አት ዎርድ ኦንሴት፤ (2) ጮንሶነንትስ (ጉትቱመቲ) ኔቬር ጌሚነቴ አት ዎርድ ኦንሴት (*ግጉግ ኢስ ኢልሌገል)፤ (3) ውሄን ትዎ ዲፍፌሬንት ቮዌልስ ሜእት ዎርድ-ሜዲአልልይ፣ ግሎትተል ስቶፕ '7' (ጊሎኦተሌይ) ኢስ ኢንሴርቴድ (እ።ግ።፣ ሰዓ፣ ነዓ፣ መዖ)፤ (4) ዶኡብሌድ ጮንሶነንትስ ሜዲአል-ኢንቴርነልልይ አሬ ፕሮኖኡንጬድ ጌሚነቴድ (ሚንኒ ነብበቤትቶኦሶነ)፤ (5) ዶኡብሌድ ቮዌልስ አሬ ፕሮኖኡንጬድ ሎንግ (አዱቅቂ ነብበቤትቶኦሶነ)፤ (6) ዲግረጵ ጮንሶነንትስ (ወአꬃ ጉትቱመቲ፦ ች፣ ꬍ፣ ꬕ፣ ኝ፣ ጵ፣ ሽ፣ ꬅ፣ ዥ) ሬፕሬሴንት አ ሲንግሌ ፆኔሜ። ዘረ 5 ፐትቴርንስ፦ ኡ (ኢ፣ እእ)፣ ጉ (በ፣ ተ፣ ኔ)፣ ጉጉ (መተ፣ ከꬂ፣ ቆፈ)፣ ጉጉግጉ (ቲሚርትቴ፣ አተርቅቀ)፣ ኡግጉጉጉ (አስትተመአሬ)፣ ጉጉኡ (ነምዕዓ፣ ገምዕዓ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 1. የጎፋኛ ቋንቋ የፊደላት አጻጻፍ ሕግጋት (Ustta = አናባቢ፣ Guttuma = ተነባቢ፣ ገጽ 63–65)፦ (1) ሁለት የተለያዩ አናባቢዎች በቃል መነሻ ላይ አይደረቡም፤ (2) ተነባቢዎች በቃል መነሻ ላይ አይጠብቁም (*GGUG አይፈቀድም)፤ (3) ሁለት አናባቢዎች በቃል መካከል ሲገናኙ ግሎታል '7' ይገባል (sa7a, na7a, ma7o)፤ (4) ተነባቢዎች በቃል ውስጥ ሲደረቡ ጠብቀው ይነበባሉ፤ (5) አናባቢዎች ሲደረቡ ተስበው (ረዝመው) ይነበባሉ፤ (6) ጥምር ተነባቢዎች (ch, dh, dz, ph, sh, th, zh) አንድ ድምፅ ይወክላሉ።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 1. Six Fundamental Gofatho Orthographic & Phonotactic Rules (Zara 5, pp. 63–65): Formalizes CV syllable templates (Ustta 'U' = Vowel, Guttuma 'G' = Consonant), bans initial consonant clusters/geminates (*GGUG) and initial vowel hiatus (*UUGU), mandates glottal stop '7' between medial vowels (sa7a, na7a, ma7o), and defines consonant gemination and vowel length.

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 2. Dhanthetetha & Sigetho/Gasetho Suffixation (pp. 66–68): Attaching bound case/postpositional suffixes (-ppe, -ra, -n, -s, -tethi, -ncha) directly to stems (Malla: Sawlappe, goshshanchcha, medheta = medho).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 2። ꬋንꬄቴꬃ & ሲጌꬆ/ገሴꬆ ሱፍፊጠቲኦን (ፕፕ። 66–68)፦ አትተቺንግ ቦኡንድ ጨሴ/ፖስትፖሲቲኦነል ሱፍፊጤስ (-ፕፔ፣ -ረ፣ -ን፣ -ስ፣ -ቴꬂ፣ -ንቻ) ዲሬጭትልይ ቶ ስቴምስ (መልለ፦ ሰውለፕፔ፣ ጎሽሻንችቻ፣ ሜꬌተ = ሜꬎ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 2. የቅጥያዎች (Dhanthetetha) እና የመስተዋድድ/አያያዥ አጠቃቀም (ገጽ 66–68)፦ ቅጥያዎችን (-ppe, -ra, -n, -s, -ncha) ከዋናው ቃል ጋር አያይዞ መጻፍ (ምሳሌ፦ Sawlappe, goshshanchcha)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 2. Bound Derivational and Inflectional Suffixation (pp. 66–68): Attaching case and agentive suffixes (-ppe, -ra, -n, -ncha) to nominal and verbal stems.

 8. DIrAAMA
SHEMPPO HOSPuNA
Qoppobata: Ha shemppuwa wurssethan tamaareti:
 " Diraama yarata shaakki qonccisana. 
 " Dumma dumma diraama qommota paattana. 
 " Diraamas ayfe qofa qonccisana.
 " Diraama qommota shaakkana.
Barkketho Oyshata
1. Diraami aybee?
2. Diraama yarata ereetii ?
3. 3.Diraama qommota ereetii ?
4. 4. Diraama kaalli ereetii? Hintte he diraamaappe demmida akeeki de7ii?
 8.1. Diraama Aybatetha
Diraama giya qaalay ″Giriike″ qaala gidishin birshshethaykka ″ooson beso″ woykko 
″qaaxo″ guussi. Diraama kaassi issi hanida taarike ooson beso hiilla. Hayssa gishin 
issi taarikiyaas besoden didirxxa bessidi duussaba akeekisiya bila ooso.
Diraami iskkiripitten giigidi diraama oothiya asan haasayoninne qaaxon poletteesippe 
attin nabbabos shiiqiyaaba gidenna.
Diraami haasayaranne qaaxora dethan shiiqidi asa na7a duussaba qonccisees. Issi 
diraama ooso bolla peeshanaw daro eranchchata hashetethan polettees hayssa gisho 
diraami cuga ooso geettetees.
 8.2. Diraama Yarata
1. Diraama Xaafanchcha
Ha diraama yaray diraamay oosettanaappe koyro tuma taarike bolla gidin paw 
aaziyaanne ha alamiyan haniyaa bata aazisidi bootha warqqate bolla qofa shuuyidi

2. Iskkiriptte
Xaafettida diraama xuufe gidishin he xuufiya diraama ooso poliya asati akeekan 
nabbabidi meezeton diraama oothoosona. Ha xuufey diraama oothiya asatan 
haasayaninne qaaxon detha bolla shiishos maaddiya xuufe.
3. Odaawa
Odaawa guussa diraama xuufiya (iskkiripttiyaa ) bolla xaafettida asata kanddo 
ma77idi diraama oothanaw geliya asata. Ha asati xaafanchchay wothida qofata 
qaaxoninne haasayan poleyssata. Diraama odaawati issoy harappe ma77ida 
kanddoninne ooso gishon dummatoosona. Ha odaawati nam77an shaakettoosona.
 3.1Bertte Odaawata
Ha odaawati diraama qaaxon doomethaappe wurssetha gaso zaari zaari benttishe, 
kunddishe, denddishe diraamay wuranaa gaso kanthidi biya asata.
 3.2Sima Odaawata
 Ha odaawati issi toho diraama giddon beettidi zaari simmonashin dhayi attiya 
odaawata guussi.
4. Hayzanchchata /xeellanchchata/
Diraama kaassay dethan shiiqiya wode kaalliya asata. Hara baggara diraamay 
duuqettidi iradoonen kooshera aadhdhiyaaba gidikko haythara hazidi diraamappe 
akeeka demmeyssata.
5. Ayfe Qofa
Xeellanchchatinne hayzanchchati pantta akeekaadan diraamaa kaallidi demmiya 
kiita.

 8.3.  Diraama Qommota
Diraami bila ooso qommo gididi berttetethan nam77an shaakettoosona. Hassatikka: 
a. Komeede diraama
b. Tiraajeede diraama
a. Komeede Diraama
Ha diraama qommoy hayzanchchata woykko xeellanchchata kaha walloyishe, 
ufayssishenne miichishe shiiqiya diraama qommo.
Ha diraamay shiiqiya wode hayzanchchati /xeellanchchati/ kaha walloyishe aathiya 
kiita woykko diraama xuura demmoosona.
b. Tiraajede Diraama
Tarajeede diraami medhuwaan dhoqqa dom77ey de7iya diraama gidishin 
hayzanchchatanne xeellanchchata kaha un77ethishe, kayoyishenne yiloyishe 
shiiqiya diraama qommo.
Ha diraama qommoy shiiqi simmishin kaallanchchati taarikiyan hanidabaa yuushon 
qiirottishenne hanqqettishe beettoosona. Hessa hanotan asa na7a bolla gakkiya 
metota akeekoosonanne qofa demmoosona.
Diraami shiiqishin naagettiyaabata 
Diraami dethan shiiqiya wode hayzanchchatappe naagettiyabati:
 1 Koyettonna qaaxereretethinne wacamethi koshshenna. 
 1 Silkkera haasayo koshshenna. 
 1 Miiye haasayo koshshenna. 
 1 Denddi eqonne hemethi koshshenna. 
 1 Doomethappe wurssetha gaso sirphphan kaalo bessees. 
Diraama kaallanchchatappe naagettiya maaray diraamay oosettishe dhubettonna 
melanne odaawati oosuwa wuda wothidi polana melassa.

Worqqa: Hay polaa! ″Erashe oychay, xeellashe sholay″ gees. Bantte aaway. Ta 
new dendda eqqada odana. Ta qofan timirttey aadhdhees. Shaloy 
beettees, dhayees, haaroy nne shaloy danon woy kayson meetettees 
timirtte eri neera merinaw de7ees. Hassa gisho timirttey aadhdhees.
Ciisha: Ero worqqa ne qofiw wurssadii ?
Worqqa: Akkay, issibaa gujjana. Shaloddey pa shaluwa maaran go7ettanaw, 
minjjanawunne dalgga alamiyaara gasethanaw aybi koshii ?
Ciisha: Timirttey koshshees.
Pola: Timirttey koshsheesishin, aadhdhey timirtte yee shalo?
Ciisha: Timirttey aadhdhees. Gaasoykka ha wodiyaan alamiyaara erettanaw, 
saynsse eran pinnanaw , teknolooje go7ettanaw tamaaro koshshees.
Tamaaronna ixxiko wodey aggidi aadhdhees.
Worqqa: Ee. Ta Ciishshaari bolla gujjiyabay, “Tamaaronna attada ase 
aaddashanaappe tamaarada go7ettana”giya qofaa mela ha77i wode 
tamaaronna atethi eggeyeesinne borssees. Ha borssuwaappe attanay 
timirtten gidiya gisho shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna.
Pola: Ta laggetoo, nu kifileppe keyida mela nu kushiya meecconashin uttida. Nu 
ayfiyaanne siidhiya bochchonnashin meecettidi simmoos.
Wolqqa: Ero takka qoppashe de7ayis yedhite. Ha wode harggiya Koroonappe nuna 
naganaw bessees.
Ciisha: Nayto timirttey aadhdheyssas ha haathaykka markka bay. Haathaa pa 
bessappe pilggidi, bookki kessidi yafaran nu timirtte keethan gukkana 
mela udidaykka timirtte era bay.
Pola: Hintte qofaan eqqada ta akeekiyaade timirtte tamaaronna asaabay tana 
qiiroyees. Hiza nu kushe meeccidi haathekka uyida. Wona bessan uttidi 
haasayana yedhdhite.
Worqqa: Hessa kanche gidenna, eran luxonna asi shalon duretikko nne qofan 
manqqo gidiya gisho panan ammannettenna. Ta ta ishata issi ginxxo

key_aligned_sentences.amharic: ድራማ የሚለው ቃል የግሪክ ቃል ሲሆን ትርጉሙም 'በተግባር ማሳየት' ወይም 'ድርጊት/እንቅስቃሴ' ማለት ነው።
key_aligned_sentences.english: The word 'drama' comes from Greek and means 'showing in action' (ooson beso) or 'movement/performance' (qaaxo).

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Worqqa: 'Shaloy beettees, dhayees, haaroynne shaloy danon woy kayson meetettees; timirtte eri neera merinaw de7ees. Hessa gisho shaloy timirtte gindde yedhdhenna.'
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ዎርቅቀ፦ 'ሻሎይ ቤእትቴእስ፣ ꬋዬእስ፣ ሀአሮይንኔ ሻሎይ ደኖን ዎይ ከይሶን ሜእቴትቴእስ፤ ቲሚርትቴ እሪ ኔእረ ሜሪነው ዴዔእስ። ሄስሰ ጊሾ ሻሎይ ቲሚርትቴ ጊንድዴ ዬꬍꬌንነ።'
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: ወርቃ፦ 'ሀብት ይገኛል፣ ይጠፋል፣ ከብትና ንብረት በአደጋ ወይም በሌባ ይወሰዳል፤ የትምህርት ዕውቀት ግን ከአንተ ጋር ለዘላለም ይኖራል። ስለዚህ ሀብት የትምህርትን ተረከዝ አይረግጥም (አይወዳደርም)።'
key_aligned_sentences.english: Worqqa: 'Wealth is found and lost, and livestock and property can be taken by disaster or thieves, whereas knowledge from education stays with you forever; therefore wealth cannot even touch the heel of education.'

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Full Classroom Drama Dialogue between Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha (pp. 72–75): Pola asks whether education (timirtte) or wealth (shalo) is greater. Worqqa and Ciisha prove that even clean piped water at school to wash hands against COVID-19 and discovering gold/silver come from education, and Worqqa recites the poem 'Timirttey al77obaa / Azallin beettenna...'. Ciisha concludes: 'Kaysoy demmonna, danoy bochenna merinaa shaluwa timirtte eraa shiisha.'
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል ጭለስስሮኦም ድረመ ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ፖለ፣ ዎርቅቀ፣ አንድ ጪኢሻ (ፕፕ። 72–75)፦ ፖለ አስክስ ውሄꬄር እዱጨቲኦን (ቲሚርትቴ) ኦር ዌአልꬅ (ሻሎ) ኢስ ግሬአቴር። ዎርቅቀ አንድ ጪኢሻ ፕሮቬ ꬃት እቬን ጭሌአን ፒፔድ ወቴር አት ስቾኦል ቶ ወሽ ሀንድስ አገኢንስት ጮቪድ-19 አንድ ዲስጮቬሪንግ ጎልድ/ሲልቬር ጮሜ ፍሮም እዱጨቲኦን፣ አንድ ዎርቅቀ ሬጪቴስ ꬄ ፖእም 'ቲሚርትቴይ አልዕዖበአ / አዘልሊን ቤእትቴንነ።።።'። ጪኢሻ ጮንጭሉዴስ፦ 'ከይሶይ ዴምሞንነ፣ ደኖይ ቦቼንነ ሜሪነአ ሻሉወ ቲሚርትቴ እረአ ሺኢሻ።'
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: የፖላ፣ የወርቃ እና የጪሻ የተውኔት ምልልስ (ገጽ 72–75)፦ ፖላ ትምህርት ይበልጣል ወይስ ሀብት ብሎ ሲጠይቅ፣ ወርቃና ጪሻ ትምህርት ከሁሉ እንደሚበልጥ በማስረጃና በግጥም ('Timirttey al77obaa...') ያስረዱታል። ጪሻም 'ሌባ የማያገኘውን፣ አደጋ የማይነካውን የዘላለም ሀብት የትምህርት ዕውቀትን ሰብስብ' ብሎ ይመክረዋል።
haasaya_dialogues.english: Three-Character Drama Dialogue (Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha, pp. 72–75): Debating whether education or material wealth is superior, incorporating COVID-19 handwashing awareness and an embedded 9-line poem praising education.

qabirshshe_ooratha_qaala_vocabulary.amharic: ዋና ገጸ-ባህሪያት (ታሪኩን ከመጀመሪያ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚያሻግሩ)
ትራጄዲ ድራማ (ከፍተኛ ግጭትና ሐዘን ያለው ተውኔት)

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Diraama Xuufe Maara (Dramatic Script Conventions & Stage Ethics, pp. 70–72): Speaker names followed by colon (:), direct first/second-person dialogue, stage movement (qaaxo), and audience etiquette (no phone calls or side chatter during a performance).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ዲረአመ ጡኡፌ መአረ (ድረመቲጭ ስጭሪፕት ጮንቬንቲኦንስ & ስተጌ እꬂጭስ፣ ፕፕ። 70–72)፦ ስፔአኬር ነሜስ ፎልሎዌድ ብይ ጮሎን (፦)፣ ዲሬጭት ፊርስት/ሴጮንድ-ፔርሶን ዲአሎጉእ፣ ስተጌ ሞቬሜንት (ቀአጦ)፣ አንድ አኡዲእንጬ እቲቁእትቴ (ኖ ፆኔ ጨልልስ ኦር ሲዴ ቻትቴር ዱሪንግ አ ፔርፎርመንጬ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: የድራማ ጽሑፍ አጻጻፍና የመድረክ ሥነ-ምግባር (ገጽ 70–72)፦ የገጸ-ባህሪያት ስምና ሁለት ነጥብ (:)፣ የገጸ-ባህሪያት ንግግርና እንቅስቃሴ (qaaxo) እንዲሁም የተመልካቾች ሥነ-ምግባር።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Dramatic Script Conventions and Audience Etiquette (pp. 70–72): Formatting character turns, stage actions (qaaxo), and theater etiquette.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: እያወቅክ ትጠይቃለህ፣ እያየህ ትሸikማለህ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: You ask what you already know, and stumble while looking straight ahead.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ሀብት የትምህርትን ተረከዝ አይረግጥም (ከትምህርት ጋር አይወዳደርም)።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Material wealth cannot even step on the heel of education (cannot compare to education).

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: በማለዳ የለቀመችውን ዶሮ ጭልፊት አያነሣትም።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: The hen that gathers her grain early in the morning is not snatched by the hawk (early diligence protects one's future).

meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_latin: Meeze Isso (II Dabbotho, p. 72): 1. Diraama -> D. Ooson beso; 2. Diraama xaafanchcha -> G. Adarsanchcha; 3. Komeede diraama -> H. Miicisiya diraama; 4. Sima odaawa -> E. Taariken beettidi dhayiya odaawata; 6. Diraami shiiqiya bessa -> A. Detha; 7. Ayfe qofa -> C. Kiita; 8. Bertte odaawata -> B. Taarikiyaan polo gakkiya odaawata.
meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ኢስሶ (ኢኢ ደብቦꬆ፣ ፕ። 72)፦ 1። ዲረአመ -> ድ። ኦኦሶን ቤሶ፤ 2። ዲረአመ ጠአፈንችቻ -> ግ። አደርሰንችቻ፤ 3። ኮሜእዴ ዲረአመ -> ህ። ሚኢጪሲየ ዲረአመ፤ 4። ሲመ ኦደአወ -> እ። ተአሪኬን ቤእትቲዲ ꬋዪየ ኦደአወተ፤ 6። ዲረአሚ ሺኢቂየ ቤስሰ -> አ። ዴꬃ፤ 7። አይፌ ቆፈ -> ጭ። ኪኢተ፤ 8። ቤርትቴ ኦደአወተ -> ብ። ተአሪኪየአን ፖሎ ገክኪየ ኦደአወተ።
meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ማዛመድ፣ ገጽ 72)፦ 1. ድራማ -> በተግባር ማሳየት፤ 2. የድራማ ጸሐፊ -> ደራሲ፤ 3. ኮሜዲ -> አስቂኝ ድራማ፤ 6. ድራማ የሚቀርብበት ቦታ -> መድረክ (Detha)፤ 7. ጭብጥ -> መልእክት (Kiita)።
meeze_student_exercises.english: Exercise 1 (Drama Terminology Matching, p. 72): 1. Diraama -> Ooson beso; 2. Playwright -> Adarsanchcha; 3. Komeede -> Miicisiya diraama; 6. Stage -> Detha; 7. Theme -> Kiita.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: Media and Communication, Report Writing, and Comparative/Contrastive Discourse

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Miidiyanne gahetetha aybatethanne go77a akeekana; markkanddo pulttotappe iripportte xaafana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ሚኢዲየንኔ ገሄቴꬃ አይበቴꬃንኔ ጎዕዓ አኬእከነ፤ መርክከንድዶ ፑልትቶተፕፔ ኢሪፕፖርትቴ ጠአፈነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: የሚዲያና የተግባቦት ምንነትንና ጥቅምን ይገነዘባሉ፤ ከመረጃ ምንጮች ሪፖርት አዘጋጅተው ይጽፋሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Understand the role of mass media and communication and write structured reports from information sources.

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Balakko (dependent) nne La77a (independent) pace meega qofata, geeddarosu (comparison) nne qeeletho (contrast) xaafo isttayle go7ettana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: በለክኮ (ዴፔንዴንት) ንኔ ለዕዓ (ኢንዴፔንዴንት) ፐጬ ሜእገ ቆፈተ፣ ጌእድደሮሱ (ጮምፐሪሶን) ንኔ ቄእሌꬆ (ጮንትረስት) ጠአፎ ኢስትተይሌ ጎዔትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: ጥገኛ (Balakko) እና ነጻ (La77a) ንዑሳን ዓረፍተ ነገሮችን እንዲሁም የማወዳደር (Geeddaro) እና የማነጻጸር (Qeeletho) የአጻጻፍ ስልቶችን ይጠቀማሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Use dependent (balakko) and independent (la77a) clauses and write comparative (geeddaro) and contrastive (qeeletho) paragraphs.

Tamaare Maxaafe

 9.1. Hayzo
I. Tamaareto Hintte Miidiyanne Gahetethaba Eranaw Koyiya Heedzu Oyshata 
Hintte Dawtaren Xaafite.
II. Hessappe Garssan Shiiqida Kaaratan Hintte Asttamaarey Shoobbida Imatha 
Haasaya Akeekkan Hayzidi Demmida Ayfe Qofata Hintte Kifile Tamaaretas 
Zaari Odite.
1. Paranje miiza haaro gade miiza haarora geeddarite.(awussi muruutan aadhii?)
2. Goofa masqqala baale bonchcho maara.
3. Beni kawotabaanne ha77i kawotabaa gathi geeddaron qonccisethi.
III. Kaallidi Miidiyanne Gahetetha Aybatetha Yuushon Shiiqida Nibaabiya 
Asttamaarey Nabbabishin Wudayi Hayzite.
Miidiyanne Gahetetha
Miidiya guussay daro asa giddoyiyaanne markkanddo issi detha akeekan 
demmanaada maaddiyaba. Gahetethi qassi daro asay issoy haraara qofanine 
markkando laameretetha hanota qonccisees. Hessadanikka miidiyanne gahetetha 
giya wode issi eqota gididi deretethaas matatethan haggaziya, pana dandda7ida 
eqotati de7iyaanne deretethappe deretethaas haggaazo immiya eqota.
Miidiyanne gahetethaba nu denthiya wode nu kahan yaanaw bessiyabay, 
ooraxxiya markkanddoy, lo77i ekkiya nashshoy, ufayssiya kabexa denthethi erisoti 
qofettoosona. Hessadanikka naagetethabati ge7etethabatinne kawotetha derethetha 
issippetethabati ubbakka sintha xeera oykkoosona. Ha hanotati deriya hachi alamey 
waani aqidaakko si7anaw naagiya asaas ho77o markkanaddota wodera hayzanaw 
koyiya haythatakkonne xeellanaw koyiya ayfetakko gathana mela moodettida eqota. 
Hayssa kanchche gidonashin eqota oosanchchati odaas gidin giigisuwas pulttoy 
de7iya bessaa gakkidi tumanne tuma (qoncce) gidida paatethi de7iyaabata shiishiya 
eqota.
Miidiya gishin daro asa giddotethaan markkanddo gathiya eqota gidikkoka pa giddon 
dumma dumma daashshata shiishidi oykees. Hessatikka satalayiten gakkiya, T.V , 
carkko zeebulisan gakkiya Iradoone, Intterneeten oothiya Fees-buukenne xaafon

74
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
gahettiya, maxaafe, mexeete, gaazexati kooshen gasethiya yethati woga kaassatinne 
poototi panttana dandda7ida miidiya qommota geetetoosona.
Hayssappe qommon paatettida miidiya eqotati asa nayta duussa bessaadaninne entta 
timirtte dethadan akeekisanaw doorotho shiiqidosona. Hessa gishin gaxare asaasinne 
xomppey gakkonna heeratas FM iradooneta, yalagatas qassi fes-buuketa nne katama 
heeratas T.V (Televizhine) go7etethay gahetethas gita injjetiyatho qofettees.
Miidiya pana dandda7ida eqota gidikoka qoppobay deriyaas lo77iyaaba zaaridi deriya 
giddo dharcciyaba. Ha eqotay paape demmiya markkanddoy baawa. De7ikkoka 
worddoppe attin deretethan ekettiyaaba gidenna. Hessa kanchche gidonnashin 
giddo oosanchchatanne zoranchchatakka deretethaa giddoppe demmees. Hayssa 
gisho haggazoy deriyaappe deriyaas gidishin, lo77iyaabata, nashettiyaabata, lo7o 
ooso polota, woga kaassata, woga yethata, deriya gakkida metotanne maadetethaa, 
hessadanikka metotappe pinnida ogetanne kawotethaa kiitata zaaridi kawotethasinne 
deretethaas xoliqqisiya eqotappe attin pa buzo qofa qonccisiya eqota gidenna.
Kuyishin, miidiya giya wode kawotethasinne deretethaas giddon de7iya dhoqqa 
zooze mela xeelettiyaba gaanaw danda7oos. Doqqa zoozey nam77u soo kooshe 
sissiya mela miidiyakka kawotethasinne dere asaas giddon de7iya eqotappe attin 
tawu buzo giya kawotethi gidin deretethi de7anaw bessenna. Ha eqotaas qoppobay

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (9።2 ሀአሰዮ፣ ፕ። 78)፦ ፕሬፐሬ አንድ ዴሊቬር ኦረል ረዲኦ/ትቭ አንኖኡንጬሜንትስ ኦን፦ 1። ኢስሲ ዎገ መዖ ሲክኪየአ ኬእꬃ እሪሶ (ትረዲቲኦነል ጭሎꬂንግ ተኢሎሪንግ ሾፕ አድ)፤ 2። ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃ ዶኦዬቴꬃአንኔ ዶኦሜꬃ እሪሶ (ስቾኦል ኦፔኒንግ አንኖኡንጬሜንት)፤ 3። መጠአፌ በይዚየ ኬእꬃንኔ ኢሜትቲየ ሀግገአዞ (ቦኦክስቶሬ ሴርቪጬ አንኖኡንጬሜንት)።
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (9.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 78)፦ የሚዲያ ማስታወቂያ አዘጋጅቶ በቃል ማቅረብ፦ 1. የባህል ልብስ ስፌት ቤት ማስታወቂያ፤ 2. የትምህርት ቤት መከፈቻ ማስታወቂያ፤ 3. የመጻሕፍት መደብር አገልግሎት ማስታወቂያ።
haasaya_dialogues.english: Exercise 2 (9.2 Oral Media Broadcasts, p. 78): Compose and present oral media advertisements/announcements for a traditional tailoring shop, school opening, or bookstore.

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 1. Balakko (Dependent) vs. La77a (Independent) Pace Meega Qofa (p. 80): Malla: 'Biri taw de7iyaako (Balakko / Conditional Dependent), eessi uyana (La77a / Independent).' 'Na7ay wonttappe utethan de7ishin (Balakko), iri puttu gis (La77a).'
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 1። በለክኮ (ዴፔንዴንት) ቭስ። ለዕዓ (ኢንዴፔንዴንት) ፐጬ ሜእገ ቆፈ (ፕ። 80)፦ መልለ፦ 'ቢሪ ተው ዴዒየአኮ (በለክኮ / ጮንዲቲኦነል ዴፔንዴንት)፣ እእስሲ ኡየነ (ለዕዓ / ኢንዴፔንዴንት)።' 'ነዓይ ዎንትተፕፔ ኡቴꬃን ዴዒሺን (በለክኮ)፣ ኢሪ ፑትቱ ጊስ (ለዕዓ)።'
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 1. ጥገኛ (Balakko) እና ነጻ (La77a) ንዑሳን ዓረፍተ ነገሮች (ገጽ 80)፦ ምሳሌ፦ 'ገንዘብ ቢኖረኝ ኖሮ (ጥገኛ/Balakko)፣ ማር እጠጣ ነበር (ነጻ/La77a)።'
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 1. Dependent (Balakko) vs. Independent (La77a) Clauses (p. 80): Conditional (-ikko/-iyaako) and simultaneous (-ishin) clauses are bound (balakko) and require a main clause (la77a).

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 2. Geeddaro (Comparison of Similarities), Qeeletho (Contrast of Differences) & Aasetho (Combined Comparison & Contrast) (pp. 81–82): Malla on 'Muuze nne Uuthi' (Banana and Enset) showing shared plant traits (Geeddaro) vs. distinct growth cycles and uses (Qeeletho).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 2። ጌእድደሮ (ጮምፐሪሶን ኦፍ ሲሚለሪቲእስ)፣ ቄእሌꬆ (ጮንትረስት ኦፍ ዲፍፌሬንጬስ) & አአሴꬆ (ጮምቢኔድ ጮምፐሪሶን & ጮንትረስት) (ፕፕ። 81–82)፦ መልለ ኦን 'ሙኡዜ ንኔ ኡኡꬂ' (በነነ አንድ እንሴት) ሾዊንግ ሻሬድ ፕለንት ትረኢትስ (ጌእድደሮ) ቭስ። ዲስቲንጭት ግሮውꬅ ጭይጭሌስ አንድ ኡሴስ (ቄእሌꬆ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 2. ማወዳደር (Geeddaro - ተመሳሳይነትን ማሳየት)፣ ማነጻጸር (Qeeletho - ልዩነትን ማሳየት) እና ማነጻጸር-ማወዳደር (Aasetho) (ገጽ 81–82)፦ ምሳሌ፦ ሙዝና እንሰትን (Muuze nne Uuthi) ማወዳደርና ማነጻጸር።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 2. Comparative (Geeddaro), Contrastive (Qeeletho), and Combined Comparative-Contrastive (Aasetho) Writing (pp. 81–82): Illustrated with Banana vs. Enset.

meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_latin: Meeze Ichchasha (9.5 Qawosa, pp. 80–81): Complete dependent clauses with independent clauses: 1. Tama eethanaw [mithi maxasu]. 2. Wudey simmishin [sa7ay omarssis]. And underline conjunctions in: 2. 'Ta yeleta bessay Sawla shin Tunggan diccas' -> 'shin'.
meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ኢችቻሻ (9።5 ቀዎሰ፣ ፕፕ። 80–81)፦ ጮምፕሌቴ ዴፔንዴንት ጭለኡሴስ ዊꬅ ኢንዴፔንዴንት ጭለኡሴስ፦ 1። ተመ እእꬃነው [ሚꬂ መጠሱ]። 2። ዉዴይ ሲምሚሺን [ሰዓይ ኦመርስሲስ]። አንድ ኡንዴርሊኔ ጮንጁንጭቲኦንስ ኢን፦ 2። 'ተ ዬሌተ ቤስሰይ ሰውለ ሺን ቱንግገን ዲጭጨስ' -> 'ሺን'።
meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 5 (ሰዋስው፣ ገጽ 80–81)፦ ጥገኛ ሐረጎችን በነጻ ዓረፍተ ነገር ማሟላትና አያያዥ ቃላትን ('shin', 'mela') መለየት።
meeze_student_exercises.english: Exercise 5 (Clause Completion & Conjunction Identification, pp. 80–81): Complete dependent clauses and identify subordinators/conjunctions ('shin', 'mela', '-ishin').

 1.C. Nabbabo 
Meeze 3
III. Kaalldi De7iyaa Nibaabiya Kifilen Kooshe Dhoqqu Udidi Nabbabidaape 
Guyen Nibaabiyaape Keyida Oyshata Zaarite.
Doona
Dooni asa na7i ubbay paas de7yaa heera ubban de7iyaa issoy issuwaara qofa, 
metuwaa, qiiruwaa, amuwaanne h.h.melata qonccisanaw go7ettiya gita miishe. 
Hessika go7etethaa, keethaawatethaara xeelliya wode sa7a bolla de7iya medoosa 
ubbatappe asa na7a kanchey go7ettiya dumma miishe guussi. Doona aybatethha 
bolla dumma dumma eranchati immida qofata xeellishin Baye Ymaamey “Dooni 
asi pa qofa wothiya oge gidishin ikka mega qofan qonccisiyaaba” I gujjidika 
“Dooni meega qofata shiiqo” gis. Hara eranchaa Admaasu Yoonnasa geetettetssi 
qassi “Dooni coo medettida qaalata shiiqo gidishin ha shiiqida qaalati he doonan 
haasa7iya dere asay akeekiya ogen kiitaa aathiya oge” gis. (12tho kifile Goofa doona 
tamaare maxaafe 2009M.L) 
Dooni asa na7as immiya go7aa hayssa mala gidi odidi wurssanaas dandda7ettennabaa 
gidikkoka kase wodeppe hachi gaso go7etetha ogey dalggishe yidayssi erettiyaaba. 
Hessika, kase wode daro laythape sinthe bayrati taariketa gidin bila odata doonara 
kaalliya yeletatas panttas go7ettiya doonaara aathishe gam7idosona. Doonay ay 
wodekka asa na7as immiyaa kothe gidida go77atappe uugati asi pa qofaa haratas 
kumethan qoncisanaas, taariketa yeletaas aathanaas, wogaa erisanaas, bila odata 
aathanaas, dumma dumma taariketa xaafi wothanaas, pilgetha oosota oothanaas, 
kare gadetara dumma dumma gade oosotas gahettanaas, timirtte tamarssanaasinne 
h.h.m go7iyaa gita miishe. Heessa mela ha7i hiloohay diccida wodiyaan dooni 
immiya go7ay ubbarakka haa guzhettis giikko borissenna. Gaasoykka Alame dethan 
asa na7i medhida carkkora kiita aathiya miishetan mallas: peesibuke, intterneete, 
telebizhine, yutuubenne h.h.m xeeloninne hayzon go7ettidi aadhiya qofata birshethi 
imon alame yuushon hachi haniyaabaa ubba kaalli be7oninne sissan ellesi qofa 
shaaketteyka doonara gidees.
Gujidikka dooni asa na7as ha doona go7aa kumethan demmonna deretethaa 
giddon asaa haasayaa si7onna issi issi asati woy hayzo metoy de7iyaa nayti

4
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
deriya giddon de7anaw dandda7iya isho hemetoy de7iyaa asati hara asatara qofaa 
laamerettanaas doonaa haasayaa si7anaw dandda7ettonna gishos he asati koyroppe 
ay ogera panttasoo asaara woy laggetara waati qofaa laamerettiyaako akeekon 
enttas qonccisanaw koshshees. Ha asatas malaatan go7ettidi doonaas imettida 
malla qaalatas birshshethi imon dumma dumma diccida heeratan metootonnashin 
go7ettoosona. Hessika deretethaara gahettiya gitabaa gidishi nu Goofa heerankka ha 
metoti de7iyaa asati woy tamaareti de7oosona. Hessika deretetha meto gidiyaa gisho 
ha metuwaa birshshanaas haasaya kooshiya si7onna naytas malla doona timirttey 
imetethaa doomidayssi daro ufayssiyaabaa gidees. 
Hara baggara dooni koyro waani medhettidee giya oyshaa daroti shiishiya gishos 
dooni koyro asi biitta bolla doommida wodeppe hachi gakkanaas pa meto un7etetha 
haraas qonccisanaw koyishin gidduwan medhettiya koosheti shiiqidi birshshethi 
de7iyaa qaalata medhishin he qaalati meega qofakko laamettishin he imettida 
birshethay issibaas buzo sunthi imettin he suntaa birshetha meezetoninne hara 
qaalata wolipe asati gahettiyaa dumma dumma bessatan mallas: beni asati muussa 
usha bessan, shankka bessaninne h.h.m bessatan meezetishin diccishe yeletape 
yeletakko aadhishe yis.
Haray qassi doonas deretethaa gahetethaara de7iyaa issipetetha baggara xeellishin 
asay panttas de7iyaa heeran dalgga dere asay lo7o wode gidin iita wodiyaan 
malla giyaan, dagon, yaaganon, yeehoninne h.h.mela bessatan wolli gahetethay 
attonnabaa gidiya gishos deretethaa gahetethaan doona go7etethay dalgga gidiya 
gisho doonasinne deretethaa gahetethaas issipetetha gahetethay keehi matees. 
Kuushan, dooni asa na7i wolira qofa laamerettanaw maaddiya gita miishe. Deretetha 
asaa giddon hayzonne haasaya metoy de7iyaa asaas woy tamaaretas malla qaalan 
woy maalaata go7etethaan qofa laamerettanaw dandda7isiya hanotatikka de7oosona. 
Doona medhetethaa baggara xeellishin asa na7i pa duussas gidi baaxetiyaa 
qaaxuwaan medhettiya kooshetas sunthi immishin medhetteyssi qoncce.
(Pulto Mokkonna Mogose)

ሜእዜ 3
ኢኢኢ። ከአልልዲ ዴዒየአ ኒበአቢየ ኪፊሌን ኮኦሼ ꬎቅቁ ኡዲዲ ነብበቢደአፔ 
ጉዬን ኒበአቢየአፔ ኬዪደ ኦይሻተ ዘአሪቴ።
ዶኦነ
ዶኦኒ አሰ ነዒ ኡብበይ ፐአስ ዴዕየአ ሄእረ ኡብበን ዴዒየአ ኢስሶይ ኢስሱወአረ ቆፈ፣ 
ሜቱወአ፣ ቂኢሩወአ፣ አሙወአንኔ ህ።ህ።ሜለተ ቆንጭጪሰነው ጎዔትቲየ ጊተ ሚኢሼ። 
ሄስሲከ ጎዔቴꬃአ፣ ኬእꬃአወቴꬃአረ ጤእልሊየ ዎዴ ሰዓ ቦልለ ዴዒየ ሜዶኦሰ 
ኡብበተፕፔ አሰ ነዓ ከንቼይ ጎዔትቲየ ዱምመ ሚኢሼ ጉኡስሲ። ዶኦነ አይበቴꬅሀ 
ቦልለ ዱምመ ዱምመ እረንቻቲ ኢምሚደ ቆፈተ ጤእልሊሺን በዬ ይመአሜይ “ዶኦኒ 
አሲ ፐ ቆፈ ዎꬂየ ኦጌ ጊዲሺን ኢክከ ሜገ ቆፈን ቆንጭጪሲየአበ” ኢ ጉጅጂዲከ 
“ዶኦኒ ሜእገ ቆፈተ ሺኢቆ” ጊስ። ሀረ እረንቻአ አድመአሱ ዮኦንነሰ ጌእቴትቴትስሲ 
ቀስሲ “ዶኦኒ ጮኦ ሜዴትቲደ ቀአለተ ሺኢቆ ጊዲሺን ሀ ሺኢቂደ ቀአለቲ ሄ ዶኦነን 
ሀአሰዒየ ዴሬ አሰይ አኬእኪየ ኦጌን ኪኢተአ አአꬂየ ኦጌ” ጊስ። (12ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈ ዶኦነ 
ተመአሬ መጠአፌ 2009ም።ል) 
ዶኦኒ አሰ ነዓስ ኢምሚየ ጎዓአ ሀይስሰ መለ ጊዲ ኦዲዲ ዉርስሰነአስ ደንድደዔትቴንነበአ 
ጊዲክኮከ ከሴ ዎዴፕፔ ሀቺ ገሶ ጎዔቴꬃ ኦጌይ ደልግጊሼ ዪደይስሲ እሬትቲየአበ። 
ሄስሲከ፣ ከሴ ዎዴ ደሮ ለይꬃፔ ሲንꬄ በይረቲ ተአሪኬተ ጊዲን ቢለ ኦደተ ዶኦነረ 
ከአልሊየ ዬሌተተስ ፐንትተስ ጎዔትቲየ ዶኦነአረ አአꬂሼ ገምዒዶሶነ። ዶኦነይ አይ 
ዎዴክከ አሰ ነዓስ ኢምሚየአ ኮꬄ ጊዲደ ጎዕዓተፕፔ ኡኡገቲ አሲ ፐ ቆፈአ ሀረተስ 
ኩሜꬃን ቆንጪሰነአስ፣ ተአሪኬተ ዬሌተአስ አአꬃነአስ፣ ዎገአ እሪሰነአስ፣ ቢለ ኦደተ 
አአꬃነአስ፣ ዱምመ ዱምመ ተአሪኬተ ጠአፊ ዎꬃነአስ፣ ፒልጌꬃ ኦኦሶተ ኦኦꬃነአስ፣ 
ከሬ ገዴተረ ዱምመ ዱምመ ገዴ ኦኦሶተስ ገሄትተነአስ፣ ቲሚርትቴ ተመርስሰነአሲንኔ 
ህ።ህ።ም ጎዒየአ ጊተ ሚኢሼ። ሄእስሰ ሜለ ሀዒ ሂሎኦሀይ ዲጭጪደ ዎዲየአን ዶኦኒ 
ኢምሚየ ጎዓይ ኡብበረክከ ሀአ ጉዤትቲስ ጊኢክኮ ቦሪስሴንነ። ገአሶይክከ አለሜ ዴꬃን 
አሰ ነዒ ሜꬊደ ጨርክኮረ ኪኢተ አአꬂየ ሚኢሼተን መልለስ፦ ፔእሲቡኬ፣ ኢንትቴርኔእቴ፣ 
ቴሌቢዢኔ፣ ዩቱኡቤንኔ ህ።ህ።ም ጤእሎኒንኔ ሀይዞን ጎዔትቲዲ አአꬊየ ቆፈተ ቢርሼꬂ 
ኢሞን አለሜ ዩኡሾን ሀቺ ሀኒየአበአ ኡብበ ከአልሊ ቤዖኒንኔ ሲስሰን እልሌሲ ቆፈ 
ሻአኬትቴይከ ዶኦነረ ጊዴእስ።
ጉጂዲክከ ዶኦኒ አሰ ነዓስ ሀ ዶኦነ ጎዓአ ኩሜꬃን ዴምሞንነ ዴሬቴꬃአ 
ጊድዶን አሰአ ሀአሰየአ ሲዖንነ ኢስሲ ኢስሲ አሰቲ ዎይ ሀይዞ ሜቶይ ዴዒየአ ነይቲ

10ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ
ዴሪየ ጊድዶን ዴዓነው ደንድደዒየ ኢሾ ሄሜቶይ ዴዒየአ አሰቲ ሀረ አሰተረ ቆፈአ 
ለአሜሬትተነአስ ዶኦነአ ሀአሰየአ ሲዓነው ደንድደዔትቶንነ ጊሾስ ሄ አሰቲ ኮይሮፕፔ 
አይ ኦጌረ ፐንትተሶኦ አሰአረ ዎይ ለግጌተረ ወአቲ ቆፈአ ለአሜሬትቲየአኮ አኬእኮን 
እንትተስ ቆንጭጪሰነው ኮሽሼእስ። ሀ አሰተስ መለአተን ጎዔትቲዲ ዶኦነአስ ኢሜትቲደ 
መልለ ቀአለተስ ቢርሽሼꬂ ኢሞን ዱምመ ዱምመ ዲጭጪደ ሄእረተን ሜቶኦቶንነሺን 
ጎዔትቶኦሶነ። ሄስሲከ ዴሬቴꬃአረ ገሄትቲየ ጊተበአ ጊዲሺ ኑ ጎኦፈ ሄእረንክከ ሀ 
ሜቶቲ ዴዒየአ አሰቲ ዎይ ተመአሬቲ ዴዖኦሶነ። ሄስሲከ ዴሬቴꬃ ሜቶ ጊዲየአ ጊሾ 
ሀ ሜቱወአ ቢርሽሻነአስ ሀአሰየ ኮኦሺየ ሲዖንነ ነይተስ መልለ ዶኦነ ቲሚርትቴይ 
ኢሜቴꬃአ ዶኦሚደይስሲ ደሮ ኡፈይስሲየአበአ ጊዴእስ። 
ሀረ በግገረ ዶኦኒ ኮይሮ ወአኒ ሜꬌትቲዴእ ጊየ ኦይሻአ ደሮቲ ሺኢሺየ ጊሾስ 
ዶኦኒ ኮይሮ አሲ ቢኢትተ ቦልለ ዶኦምሚደ ዎዴፕፔ ሀቺ ገክከነአስ ፐ ሜቶ ኡንዔቴꬃ 
ሀረአስ ቆንጭጪሰነው ኮዪሺን ጊድዱወን ሜꬌትቲየ ኮኦሼቲ ሺኢቂዲ ቢርሽሼꬂ 
ዴዒየአ ቀአለተ ሜꬊሺን ሄ ቀአለቲ ሜእገ ቆፈክኮ ለአሜትቲሺን ሄ ኢሜትቲደ 
ቢርሼꬃይ ኢስሲበአስ ቡዞ ሱንꬂ ኢሜትቲን ሄ ሱንተአ ቢርሼꬃ ሜእዜቶኒንኔ ሀረ 
ቀአለተ ዎሊፔ አሰቲ ገሄትቲየአ ዱምመ ዱምመ ቤስሰተን መልለስ፦ ቤኒ አሰቲ ሙኡስሰ 
ኡሻ ቤስሰን፣ ሻንክከ ቤስሰኒንኔ ህ።ህ።ም ቤስሰተን ሜእዜቲሺን ዲጭጪሼ ዬሌተፔ 
ዬሌተክኮ አአꬊሼ ዪስ።
ሀረይ ቀስሲ ዶኦነስ ዴሬቴꬃአ ገሄቴꬃአረ ዴዒየአ ኢስሲፔቴꬃ በግገረ ጤእልሊሺን 
አሰይ ፐንትተስ ዴዒየአ ሄእረን ደልግገ ዴሬ አሰይ ሎዖ ዎዴ ጊዲን ኢኢተ ዎዲየአን 
መልለ ጊየአን፣ ደጎን፣ የአገኖን፣ ዬእሆኒንኔ ህ።ህ።ሜለ ቤስሰተን ዎልሊ ገሄቴꬃይ 
አትቶንነበአ ጊዲየ ጊሾስ ዴሬቴꬃአ ገሄቴꬃአን ዶኦነ ጎዔቴꬃይ ደልግገ ጊዲየ 
ጊሾ ዶኦነሲንኔ ዴሬቴꬃአ ገሄቴꬃአስ ኢስሲፔቴꬃ ገሄቴꬃይ ኬእሂ መቴእስ። 
ኩኡሻን፣ ዶኦኒ አሰ ነዒ ዎሊረ ቆፈ ለአሜሬትተነው መአድዲየ ጊተ ሚኢሼ። ዴሬቴꬃ 
አሰአ ጊድዶን ሀይዞንኔ ሀአሰየ ሜቶይ ዴዒየአ አሰአስ ዎይ ተመአሬተስ መልለ ቀአለን 
ዎይ መአለአተ ጎዔቴꬃአን ቆፈ ለአሜሬትተነው ደንድደዒሲየ ሀኖተቲክከ ዴዖኦሶነ። 
ዶኦነ ሜꬌቴꬃአ በግገረ ጤእልሊሺን አሰ ነዒ ፐ ዱኡስሰስ ጊዲ በአጤቲየአ 
ቀአጡወአን ሜꬌትቲየ ኮኦሼተስ ሱንꬂ ኢምሚሺን ሜꬌትቴይስሲ ቆንጭጬ።

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Gasethota (Discourse Connectors in Context, 1.F Qawosa, p. 11): (1) Hessa gisho ('therefore'), (2) Gidoppe attin ('however/but'), (3) Hessa mala ('likewise/similarly'), (4) Gujjidikka ('furthermore/moreover'), (5) Kaallidi ('subsequently/next').
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ገሴꬆተ (ዲስጮኡርሴ ጮንኔጭቶርስ ኢን ጮንቴጥት፣ 1።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕ። 11)፦ (1) ሄስሰ ጊሾ ('ꬄሬፎሬ')፣ (2) ጊዶፕፔ አትቲን ('ሆዌቬር/ቡት')፣ (3) ሄስሰ መለ ('ሊኬዊሴ/ሲሚለርልይ')፣ (4) ጉጅጂዲክከ ('ፉርꬄርሞሬ/ሞሬኦቬር')፣ (5) ከአልሊዲ ('ሱብሴቁእንትልይ/ኔጥት')።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: አያያዥ ቃላት (Gasethota፣ ገጽ 11)፦ (1) Hessa gisho (ስለዚህ)፣ (2) Gidoppe attin (ነገር ግን)፣ (3) Hessa mala (እንደዚሁም)፣ (4) Gujjidikka (በተጨማሪም)፣ (5) Kaallidi (ቀጥሎም)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Discourse Connectors in Context (p. 11): Hessa gisho ('therefore'), Gidoppe attin ('however'), Hessa mala ('likewise'), Gujjidikka ('furthermore'), and Kaallidi ('next').

Timirtte tamaaroy daro bonchisees; [gujjidikka] kare gade gaso efees. 5. Macho ekkanaw koyro na7entta soo cima yeddees; [kaallidi] doona pogiso immees.

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Goofan beni wode eko gelo wogaa (Laazanthi, Doona pogo, Soofe, Yaagano, Guluntha qaaro, Sadan wodha, Githe) paattana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈን ቤኒ ዎዴ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገአ (ለአዘንꬂ፣ ዶኦነ ፖጎ፣ ሶኦፌ፣ የአገኖ፣ ጉሉንꬃ ቀአሮ፣ ሰደን ዎꬋ፣ ጊꬄ) ፐአትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: በጎፋ የጥንት ባህላዊ የጋብቻ ሥርዓት ደረጃዎችን (ሽምግልና/Laazanthi፣ ቃል ማሰሪያ/Doona pogo፣ ሶፌ፣ ሠርግ/Yaagano፣ መልስ/Githe) ያብራራሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Analyze traditional Gofatho marriage customs and ceremonies (Laazanthi, Doona pogo, Soofe, Yaagano, Guluntha qaaro, Sadan wodha, Githe).

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Meega qofa qommota (Oysho, Kiita, Paate, Malalo) entti immiyaa go7aan zemppidi shaakki xaafidi go7ettana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ሜእገ ቆፈ ቆምሞተ (ኦይሾ፣ ኪኢተ፣ ፐአቴ፣ መለሎ) እንትቲ ኢምሚየአ ጎዓአን ዜምፕፒዲ ሻአክኪ ጠአፊዲ ጎዔትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: የዓረፍተ ነገር ዓይነቶችን (ጥያቄያዊ፣ ትዕዛዛዊ፣ ገላጭና አጋናኝ) በአገልግሎታቸው ለይተው ይጽፋሉ።

Asa na7i shempora de7iyaa medosatappe issuwa. Shemppoy de7iabata kanddotappe 
issoy qassi yeletethi. Asa na7i shempora de7idi susasy duuxxonna melanne kochay 
dhayonna mela beni sisa wodeppe oykkidi ekkishenne gelishe yelishe ha7i gaso 
biitta bolla daridi de7is. Gidishin, eko gelo wogay heerappe heeran dummatiyaaba 
gidishin bini wode Goofa heeraa eko gelo wogaa kaalliya daassatan xeellana.
Beni wode ichashu gidiya eko gelo wogati de7oosona. Hessatikka sinthara gelo, 
guyera gelo, dafa, githenne utetha gelo geetettoosona.
Koyroy sinthara gelo gidishin, eko gelos gakkida pantha na7ay daro dosida na7ees 
aawa aayi baggara heedzu cima soo yeddees. Hessika, na7aasinne na7ees kochan 
ixoy woy dabbotethi baynnabaa gidikko kanche. He cimatika ero gaana gaso zaari 
zaaridi oychoosona, giigisoosona. Ha oysho wogaa sintha kushe ekkidi polos gathey 
aawaanne aayiw.
Nam7anthoy guyera gelo gidishin hessika, aawi aayiya eronna woy si7onna na7aara 
na7eera wolira siiqettidaappe labi zaarana mela laazanthi yeddoosona. He laazanthay, 
yaaganoninne dumma dumma bessatan shoobbees. Hessika na7ee dabbota maadon 
giyan na7iw dabbotara ushoninne nashon na7aas ero udoosona. Hessape guyen eko 
gelo polees.
Heedzanthoy qaassi dafi eko gidishin, na7ay daro siiqida na7iya sinthara gidin guyera 
oychin ixxidabaa gidikko na7ay pa laggetara pana giigisidi dafos oge aadhdhees. 
Hessika haney, giya ogen, yeeho ogen, yaaganon, haatha ogeninne kiita bessape 
yishin gidanaw dandda7ees. Woranzo gidonna mela laappunappe woy hosppunappe 
dariya cima yeddees. Cimatikka zaari zaari woossidi ero udoosona.
Oyddanthoykka qassi gixxidi ekkeyssagidishin, ha eko gelo wogan na7iyaanne 
na7ay na7entta soo asay kasetidi oyshettonnaninne qopponna na7ay kase oychi

ነዔእረ ዎሊረ ሲኢቄትቲደአፕፔ ለቢ ዘአረነ ሜለ ለአዘንꬂ ዬድዶኦሶነ። ሄ ለአዘንꬃይ፣ 
የአገኖኒንኔ ዱምመ ዱምመ ቤስሰተን ሾኦብቤእስ። ሄስሲከ ነዔእ ደብቦተ መአዶን 
ጊየን ነዒው ደብቦተረ ኡሾኒንኔ ነሾን ነዓአስ እሮ ኡዶኦሶነ። ሄስሰፔ ጉዬን እኮ 
ጌሎ ፖሌእስ።
ሄእꬓንꬆይ ቀአስሲ ደፊ እኮ ጊዲሺን፣ ነዓይ ደሮ ሲኢቂደ ነዒየ ሲንꬃረ ጊዲን ጉዬረ 
ኦይቺን ኢጥጢደበአ ጊዲክኮ ነዓይ ፐ ለግጌተረ ፐነ ጊኢጊሲዲ ደፎስ ኦጌ አአꬍꬌእስ። 
ሄስሲከ ሀኔይ፣ ጊየ ኦጌን፣ ዬእሆ ኦጌን፣ የአገኖን፣ ሀአꬃ ኦጌኒንኔ ኪኢተ ቤስሰፔ 
ዪሺን ጊደነው ደንድደዔእስ። ዎረንዞ ጊዶንነ ሜለ ለአፕፑነፕፔ ዎይ ሆስፕፑነፕፔ 
ደሪየ ጪመ ዬድዴእስ። ጪመቲክከ ዘአሪ ዘአሪ ዎኦስሲዲ እሮ ኡዶኦሶነ።
ኦይድደንꬆይክከ ቀስሲ ጊጥጢዲ እክኬይስሰጊዲሺን፣ ሀ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገን ነዒየአንኔ 
ነዓይ ነዔንትተ ሶኦ አሰይ ከሴቲዲ ኦይሼትቶንነኒንኔ ቆፕፖንነ ነዓይ ከሴ ኦይቺ

ተመአሬ መጠአፌ
ጊኢጊሲደ መቺው ሀሪ እክኪኮ ሄ ሜቱወአ ገአሱወን ደሮ ጪመቲ ንምዕዑ ሄእꬑ 
ቀምመን መይዘ መዕዔ ዎገን ጊጥጢዲ ዬለ አሰአ ዎኦስሲ ጦኦኒዲ እክኪ ቦኦሶነ። 
ሀረይ ቀስሲ በይረይ ዴዒሺን ከአሎይ ዎይ ጌዴኖይ እክኪኮ በይረአስ መቾ ጊጥጢዲ 
ኢምሞኦሶነ። 
ኢቻሻንꬆይ ቀስሲ ኡቴꬃ ጌሎ ጊዲሺን፣ ሄስሲከ ነምዑን ሻአሄትቴእስ። ኮይሮይ 
አትቱመይ እክከነ ጊዲ ኦይቺደአፕፔ ጉዬ ሲዕዒ ጊዲ ገምዕዒኮ ነዓይ ፐ ለግጌረ 
ከአዒሺን ኬእሴይ ኬዪየአ ሜለ ጊዲክኮ ኦመርስሰ ገልለስ ሄ ኦይቺዲ አግጊደ ነዓአ 
ሶኦ በደ ኡትተደ ነአገውሱ። ሄ ነዓይ ፐ ሶኦአሰአረ ዎይ ሾኦሮተረ ዞሬትቲዲ ጉዬ 
ሲምመነአስ ቤስሶንነበአ ጊዲደ ጊሾ ነዒው እክኪ አግጌእስ። ነምዓንꬆ ኦጌይ ቀስሲ 
ጌእለዖቴꬃን ደሮ ለይꬂ ገምዕዒድ አሊደ ኢስሲ ኢስሲ ጌእለዖቲ ሀረ አሲ ኦደን ቦቺኮ 
ዎይ ሄ ኡረአረ ጉኡꬃ ለግጌቴꬂ ዴዒየአበ ጊዲክኮ ኡረአ ሶኦ ቢዲ ኡትቶኦስነ። ሀረ 
መቻ ዴዒየአበ ጊዲክኮከ ዎጊ ዴዒየአ ጊሾ እክኬእስ፤ ዎልለ ሶይዞኦሶነ።
ኢ። ከአልሊዲ ኒበአቢየፕፔ ኬዪደ ኦይሾተ ቀአለን ዘአሪቴ።
1። ቤኒ ዎዴ ጎኦፈን እኮ ጌሎ ዎገይ ወአኒ ፖሌትቲ?

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Asa na7i shempora de7idi susay duuxxonna melanne kochay dhayonna mela beni sisa wodeppe oykkidi ekkishenne gelishe yelishe ha7i gaso biitta bolla daridi de7is.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: አሰ ነዒ ሼምፖረ ዴዒዲ ሱሰይ ዱኡጥጦንነ ሜለንኔ ኮቻይ ꬋዮንነ ሜለ ቤኒ ሲሰ ዎዴፕፔ ኦይክኪዲ እክኪሼንኔ ጌሊሼ ዬሊሼ ሀዒ ገሶ ቢኢትተ ቦልለ ደሪዲ ዴዒስ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: የሰው ልጅ በሕይወት ኖሮ ዘሩ እንዳይቋረጥና ትውልዱ እንዳይጠፋ ከጥንት ጊዜ ጀምሮ እያገባና እየተዳረ እየወለደ እስከ አሁን በምድር ላይ በዝቶ ይኖራል።
key_aligned_sentences.english: So that the human lineage does not break, humanity has married and raised generations from ancient times to the present.

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Kase doona pogoy imettees; yaagano qaray gam77ishe ekettees; saamintti gelos attishin soofey de7ees; wurssethan yaaganoy dimbbakees.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ከሴ ዶኦነ ፖጎይ ኢሜትቴእስ፤ የአገኖ ቀረይ ገምዕዒሼ እኬትቴእስ፤ ሰአሚንትቲ ጌሎስ አትቲሺን ሶኦፌይ ዴዔእስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃን የአገኖይ ዲምብበኬእስ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: መጀመሪያ የቃል ማሰሪያ (doona pogo) ይሰጣል፤ የሠርጉ ቀጠሮ ይቆረጣል፤ ለሠርጉ አንድ ሳምንት ሲቀረው የ'ሶፌ' ሥርዓት ይደረጋል፤ በመጨረሻም ሠርጉ በነጋሪት/ከበሮ ይደምቃል።
key_aligned_sentences.english: First the betrothal gift (doona pogo) is given, the wedding date is set, the pre-wedding market parade (soofe) takes place a week before, and finally the wedding feast (yaagano) is celebrated with drums.

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Full 22-Turn Dialogue between Students Orzaamo and Murqqenna (2.B Haasaya, pp. 13–14): Orzaamo: 'Beni wode eko gelo wogaabaa neeni eray?' Murqqenna: 'Ee, guuthara erays... Aawaara aayeera zorettidi onttako na7iya lo7o; kochayka lo7o gidi cima yeddoosona... Hessa cimi wurssees gees. "Cimi shi7a muzees" giya tossiyaa si7a erikkii?... Na7iyaa puutto oykkada dakko, gaabe, laxana daddawus. Na7ay keethe keexxidi cumees... Soo ekki gakkishin na7aa aawaay xamaata ekkidi... "Yelettite ayfite, na7a na7as biyi na7as gakkite" gidi anjjees.'
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል 22-ቱርን ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ስቱዴንትስ ኦርዘአሞ አንድ ሙርቅቄንነ (2።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕፕ። 13–14)፦ ኦርዘአሞ፦ 'ቤኒ ዎዴ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገአበአ ኔእኒ እረይ?' ሙርቅቄንነ፦ 'እእ፣ ጉኡꬃረ እረይስ።።። አአወአረ አአዬእረ ዞሬትቲዲ ኦንትተኮ ነዒየ ሎዖ፤ ኮቻይከ ሎዖ ጊዲ ጪመ ዬድዶኦሶነ።።። ሄስሰ ጪሚ ዉርስሴእስ ጌእስ። "ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜእስ" ጊየ ቶስሲየአ ሲዓ እሪክኪኢ?።።። ነዒየአ ፑኡትቶ ኦይክከደ ደክኮ፣ ገአቤ፣ ለጠነ ደድደዉስ። ነዓይ ኬእꬄ ኬእጥጢዲ ጩሜእስ።።። ሶኦ እክኪ ገክኪሺን ነዓአ አአወአይ ጠመአተ እክኪዲ።።። "ዬሌትቲቴ አይፊቴ፣ ነዓ ነዓስ ቢዪ ነዓስ ገክኪቴ" ጊዲ አንጅጄእስ።'
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: በተማሪ ኦርዛሞ እና በተማሪ ሙርቄና መካከል የተደረገ ባለ 22 ተራ ምልልስ (ገጽ 13–14)፦ ስለ ጎፋ ባህላዊ ጋብቻ ሽምግልና፣ ስለ ሙሽሪት ጥጥ መፍተልና የሙሽራው ቤት መሥራትና ተክል መትከል (cumees)፣ ስለ ሠርግ (yaagano) እና የሙሽራው አባት በእርጎ (xamaata) እግራቸውን እያነካካ 'ውለዱ ክበዱ፣ ለልጅ ልጅ ድረሱ' ብሎ ስለሚመርቅበት ሥርዓት።

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ትረንስፎርሚንግ ጩልቱረል ሌጤሜስ አጭሮስስ 4 ሴንቴንጬ ሞኦድስ (2።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕ። 18)፦ መልለስ ፎር 'ለአዘንꬂ' & 'ቆልሌ'፦ (1) ኦይሾ፦ 'አልመአዞ አከአሉስ ለአዘንꬂ ኦይቺዴእ?' (2) ኪኢተ፦ 'አስቲሬ አኔ ተው ቆልሌ ደድደ።' (3) ፐአቴ፦ 'አከአሎይ ለአዘንꬂ ዬድዲስ።' (4) መለሎ፦ 'ሀንነ ቆልሊየ ወአነ ሎዕዓይ!'
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: ቃላትን በአራቱ የዓረፍተ ነገር ዓይነቶች (ጥያቄያዊ፣ ትዕዛዛዊ፣ ገላጭና አጋናኝ) መጠቀም (ገጽ 18)፦ ምሳሌ፦ 'አልማዞን ለአካሉ ሽማግሌ ጠየቀለት ወይ?' (ጥያቄ)፤ 'አስቴር እባክሽ ጥጥ ፍተይልኝ' (ትዕዛዝ/ልመና)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Sentence Mood Transformations (2.F Qawosa, p. 18): Constructing interrogative, imperative, declarative, and exclamatory sentences for 10 cultural nouns (Laazanthi, Qolle, Githe, Soofe, Soyzo, Yaagano, Medda, Sayo, Wodalla, Bollo).

chapters.title_english: Chapter 3: Women and Development, Biography of Mishire Amaarachi Aggido, and Full Sentence Syntax

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Maccatas gade dichaa bolla de7iya gishaaddetethaa (Mre Illeni & Mre Amaarachi Aggido taarike) nabbaboninne hayzon akeekana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: መጭጨተስ ገዴ ዲቻአ ቦልለ ዴዒየ ጊሻአድዴቴꬃአ (ምሬ ኢልሌኒ & ምሬ አመአረቺ አግጊዶ ተአሪኬ) ነብበቦኒንኔ ሀይዞን አኬእከነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: ሴቶች በአገር ልማት ላይ ያላቸውን ሚና (የወ/ሮ እሌኒ እና የወ/ሮ አማረች አጊዶን የሕይወት ታሪክ) በማዳመጥና በማንበብ ይገነዘባሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Understand women's leadership in development through the biographies of pilot Mre Illeni and scholar Mre Amaarachi Aggido.

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Goofatho qawosa wogan meega qofa medhuwa (Yohaadde + Kaalodde + Peesho) nne meega qofa qommota go7ettana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ቀዎሰ ዎገን ሜእገ ቆፈ ሜꬉወ (ዮሀአድዴ + ከአሎድዴ + ፔእሾ) ንኔ ሜእገ ቆፈ ቆምሞተ ጎዔትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: በጎፋኛ ሰዋስው የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀርን (ባለቤት + ተሳቢ + ግስ) እና የዓረፍተ ነገር ዓይነቶችን ይጠቀማሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Master Gofatho SOV sentence syntax (Yohaadde Subject + Kaalodde Object + Peesho Verb) and clause types.

nabbabo_reading_passages.passage_title_english: Biography of Mishire Amaarachi Aggido: Pioneer Female Scholar from Southern Ethiopia
nabbabo_reading_passages.full_passage_gofatho_latin:
15
Tamaare Maxaafe
 3.B. Haasaya
Meeze 2
II. Kaallidi Shiiqida Kaarata Bolla Cugan Cugan Tobbite. 
1. Maccatas gade dichaa bolla de7iya gishaaddetethay ay aazii?
2. Maccatasinne attumatas de7iya ginatethaa bolla haasayite.
3. Maccati ubba ooson hasheteyssi gade dichaas lo7o woy iita geyssa bolla 
haasayite.
4. Macca nayti ubbaban gina hashetana mela oosettanaw bessiyabaata bolla 
haasayite.
5. Maccati laames tamaaro koshshiiyee zal77e koshshiyaako odettite.
 3.C. Nabbabo
 
Misile 3 
Mishire (Mre) Amaarachi Aggido geetettiyaara Dugeha Tophphiyan luxida 
maccasatappe issiwu. Iya yelettiday Wolaytha zoone Boloso Soore woradana. Iyakka, 
pantta soo asaas oyddantho na7a gida oyddu maccanne usuppun adde nayti gididi 
yelettida dalgga keethaa giddon diccasu. Keetha asaykka timirttes de7iya qofay 
keehi dalgga. Iis aaway Sudaane gaden Intterire geetettiya Mishinen payyatethaa 
pilggetha hiillaa tamaaris. Hara baggara qassi, wonggele ooso haggaziya asi gidida 
pa nayti attoshin pa heera asaa nayti ubbati timirtte tamaarana mela denthethiya

16
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
ase. Hessape denddidayssan, heeraape tamaaridi dhoqqa dethaanne aawatethaas 
gakkida daroti de7oosona. I aawaa denthethoynne tamaaro miishata haggazoy iipe 
shaahettonnashin tamaaridayssa doona kuntha odawusu.
Iya duuden de7ishin I aaway koyro detha asttamaareta haasayisidi gallasa timirtte 
tamaaranaw dandda7onna heera nayta omarssi omarssi soo gidon xomppera 
woy paanosera tamaarana mela oothishe gam77is. Heera asati guyepe “Dargge 
kawotethaa wode baaso timirtte kaaloy yishin Aggido wolqqan pidale nu sinthe 
eri uttida” gidosona. Guussayka, pidale toho shaaho kanche gidonnashin xaafidi 
nabbabonne pirmma dandda7ana mela iya timirttey oothis. 
Mre Amaarachi Aggidoy issanthope bada heedzantho kifile timirtte tamaariday 
heeran de7iyaa woosa keethaana. Oyddanthope usuppuntho kifile gaso guuthi 
haakki ekkiya Sudaane Itteriyeere Mishinen (SIM) timirtte keethana gidishin he 
timirtte kethankka addetassape attin macca naytas aqiyaa bessi baynna gishos iya 
aqey dabbo asa soona. Dabbo keethan aqoppe attin xanna7anaasinne issi issibaatas 
daro injjey baawa. Gidikkonne, un77etethan saamintta gam77ada Laame galasi 
saaminttan issi wode soo asaakko simeretteyssi iis aykkoka aazenna. He timirtte 
keethaan aadhdhiya timirttey lo77onne kumethi gidiya gishos iya minnana mela udis. 
He timirtte keethaan Inggilizetho doona timirttey paranjjetan imettiya gishonne iya 
timirttiyaan gooba gidiya gishos kifile tamaaretappe issanthope heedzantho detha 
gaso kanche keyawusu. 
Laappunthope hospuntho gaso de7iyaa timirttiya Sooddo ammaniyaa asata timirtte 
keethan ha7i Sooddo( Otona) Hosppitaaley de7iyaa heeran tamaarasu. He timirtte 
keethay aqo timirtte keetha (boarding school) gidiyaa gishos aqiya bessayka iyan 
de7ees. Nam77antho detha timirttiyaa Sooddo nam77antho detha timirtte keethan 
tamaarada Otona simeretta aqawusu. Hessa ubbaa haniya wode sintha mino qofi 
de7iya gisho daaburssi iis si7ettenna. Hessa ubbaa hanashe pa soo asaakko Laame 
qamman soo simmada soo asaas dumma dumma metota maaddashe asaa daro 
ufayssiyaa na7a. 
Tammantho kifile gakkashe azina geloppe attin timirttiyaa qanxxonna tammanne 
nam77antho kifile wurssada I azinay ekkida qammape doomidi iyo kaallishe gam7is. 
Hessa yaani de7ishin koyro digire timirtte tamaaro bolla de7ashe yelida nam77u 
nayta azinaa soo asati dichoosona. Soo asay dichishe entta tamarssanaas keehi

17
Tamaare Maxaafe
baaxetidosona. 1975 M.Laythan, Tungga yunbburssen Deretetha Saynsse timirtten 
anjjettada ooso oykkasu. Hessape guye Mastterete timirtte qaada demmada iya kare 
gade keyishin I azinay haan attidi naytta baaloyi dichchishe salettonna aawatethan 
dichishe gam7is. Hessika daro mino maccata guye taarikiya pilggi xeelliyaade 
azinata maadey de7eyssa bessees. Aybis giikko, I azinay iyo darope kaalleyssanne 
maaddeyssa be7ada iyakka odawusu. 
Wurssethan iya “Ta naytoo, ta micheto, macca tamaaretoo ay wodekka qantha wode 
meton xoonettidi hintte timirttiyaape guye gooppite” gasu. Gujjadakka, “Metoy 
ubbi aadhdhees; kushe immiko qassi hemetuwaan qashetti atethi medhettees; 
ubbarakka ha77i wode cimmiyaabatinne leelisiyaabati de7iyaa gisho macca nayti 
loythidi naagettanaw koshshees. Minnidi yiikko qassi geli yelidaappeka guye 
tamaaroy dandda7etteyssa taappe tamaarite. Hara baggara qassi hinttes wodey 
kaseppe lo77idi timirtte keethay matan de7ees, guuxxin darin tamaare maxaafey 
benttees, iraadooneynne telebijiney de7ees. Hessa gishos, ha qaadaa ubbata wodera 
go7ettanaw koshshees” gasu. 
(Pulttoy luxida maccasata 1990 M.L. Toosoo Tophphe Timirtte Biiro.)
Meeze 3
I. Kaallidi Qommo Nibaabiyaape Shiiqida Oyshota Qaalan Zaarite.
1. Payyatetha pilggetha ooso tamaariday oonee?
2. Asati tamaaridi dhoqqa dethanne aawatethas daroti gakkida gaasoy,nibaabiyaadan, 
aybee?
3. “Aggido wolqqan pidale nu sinthe eri uttida” giday oonee?
4. Dn. Aggidoy gallasa timirtte tamaaranaw dandda7onna pa heera asatas ayba 
giigisidee?
5. Mre Amaarachi Aggidoy aappuntha kifile gaso tamaaradee? 
6. Mre Amaaracha “Ta michetoo, ta aayetoo ta naytoo, macca tamaaretoo” 
yaagada ooddes zore immadee?
7. Mre Amaaracha koyro digire tamaaro bolla de7ashe yelida nam77u nayta 
dichchey oonee?

ተመአሬ መጠአፌ
 3።ብ። ሀአሰየ
ሜእዜ 2
ኢኢ። ከአልሊዲ ሺኢቂደ ከአረተ ቦልለ ጩገን ጩገን ቶብቢቴ።

 3።ጭ። ነብበቦ
 
ሚሲሌ 3 
ሚሺሬ (ምሬ) አመአረቺ አግጊዶ ጌእቴትቲየአረ ዱጌሀ ቶጵጪየን ሉጢደ 
መጭጨሰተፕፔ ኢስሲዉ። ኢየ ዬሌትቲደይ ዎለይꬃ ዞኦኔ ቦሎሶ ሶኦሬ ዎረደነ። ኢየክከ፣ 
ፐንትተ ሶኦ አሰአስ ኦይድደንꬆ ነዓ ጊደ ኦይድዱ መጭጨንኔ ኡሱፕፑን አድዴ ነይቲ ጊዲዲ 
ዬሌትቲደ ደልግገ ኬእꬃአ ጊድዶን ዲጭጨሱ። ኬእꬃ አሰይክከ ቲሚርትቴስ ዴዒየ ቆፈይ 
ኬእሂ ደልግገ። ኢኢስ አአወይ ሱደአኔ ገዴን ኢንትቴሪሬ ጌእቴትቲየ ሚሺኔን ፐይየቴꬃአ 
ፒልግጌꬃ ሂኢልለአ ተመአሪስ። ሀረ በግገረ ቀስሲ፣ ዎንግጌሌ ኦኦሶ ሀግገዚየ አሲ ጊዲደ 
ፐ ነይቲ አትቶሺን ፐ ሄእረ አሰአ ነይቲ ኡብበቲ ቲሚርትቴ ተመአረነ ሜለ ዴንꬄꬂየ

16
10ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ
አሴ። ሄስሰፔ ዴንድዲደይስሰን፣ ሄእረአፔ ተመአሪዲ ꬎቅቀ ዴꬃአንኔ አአወቴꬃአስ

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 1. Goofatho Meega Qofa Medhuwa (SOV Word Order: Yohaadde + Kaalodde + Peesho, p. 24): Goofatho qawosa wogan koyro yohaaddey, kaallidi kaaloddey, wurssethan peeshoy (Y + K + P) yees. Mallas: 'Na7ay (Y) uketha (K) mis (P).' (Contrast with English SVO).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 1። ጎኦፈꬆ ሜእገ ቆፈ ሜꬉወ (ሶቭ ዎርድ ኦርዴር፦ ዮሀአድዴ + ከአሎድዴ + ፔእሾ፣ ፕ። 24)፦ ጎኦፈꬆ ቀዎሰ ዎገን ኮይሮ ዮሀአድዴይ፣ ከአልሊዲ ከአሎድዴይ፣ ዉርስሴꬃን ፔእሾይ (ይ + ክ + ፕ) ዬእስ። መልለስ፦ 'ነዓይ (ይ) ኡኬꬃ (ክ) ሚስ (ፕ)።' (ጮንትረስት ዊꬅ እንግሊሽ ስቮ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 1. የጎፋኛ ዓረፍተ ነገር የቃላት አሰካክ (ባለቤት + ተሳቢ + ግስ / Y + K + P፣ ገጽ 24)፦ በጎፋኛ ሰዋስው መጀመሪያ ባለቤት (Yohaadde)፣ ቀጥሎ ተሳቢ (Kaalodde)፣ በመጨረሻ ግስ (Peesho) ይመጣል። ምሳሌ፦ 'ልጁ (Y) እንጀራ (K) በላ (P)።'
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 1. Canonical SOV Word Order in Gofatho (Yohaadde + Kaalodde + Peesho, p. 24): Subject (Yohaadde) + Object (Kaalodde) + Verb (Peesho).

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 2. Meega Qofa Qommota Kiitaan (Paate [Eenota & Akkayta], Oysho, Malalo, Kiita) & Medhuwan (Yeda, Dakko, Walaka/Gite, Dakko Gite) (pp. 24–28): Includes affirmative (eenota: 'Macca tamaareti puuto tokkidosona') vs. negative (akkayta: 'Maccata maadey baynna gadey diccenna') declarative sentences, and all 4 structural sentence types.
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 2። ሜእገ ቆፈ ቆምሞተ ኪኢተአን (ፐአቴ [እእኖተ & አክከይተ]፣ ኦይሾ፣ መለሎ፣ ኪኢተ) & ሜꬉወን (ዬደ፣ ደክኮ፣ ወለከ/ጊቴ፣ ደክኮ ጊቴ) (ፕፕ። 24–28)፦ ኢንጭሉዴስ አፍፊርመቲቬ (እእኖተ፦ 'መጭጨ ተመአሬቲ ፑኡቶ ቶክኪዶሶነ') ቭስ። ኔገቲቬ (አክከይተ፦ 'መጭጨተ መአዴይ በይንነ ገዴይ ዲጭጬንነ') ዴጭለረቲቬ ሴንቴንጬስ፣ አንድ አልል 4 ስትሩጭቱረል ሴንቴንጬ ትይፔስ።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 2. የዓረፍተ ነገር ዓይነቶች በመልእክታቸው (አዎንታዊና አሉታዊ ገላጭ፣ ጥያቄያዊ፣ አጋናኝ፣ ትዕዛዛዊ) እና በመዋቅራቸው (ነጠላ/Yeda፣ ድርብ/Dakko፣ ውስብስብ/Walaka፣ ድርብ ውስብስብ/Dakko Gite) (ገጽ 24–28)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 2. Complete Taxonomy of Gofatho Sentences by Mood (Affirmative/Eenota & Negative/Akkayta Declarative, Interrogative, Exclamatory, Imperative) and by Clause Complexity (Simple/Yeda, Compound/Dakko, Complex/Walaka, Compound-Complex/Dakko Gite) (pp. 24–28).

meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 6 (ሰዋስው፣ ገጽ 26)፦ 1. አሉታዊ ገላጭ ዓ.ነገር (Paate)፤ 2. ጥያቄያዊ ዓ.ነገር (Oysho)፤ 3. አጋናኝ ዓ.ነገር (Malalo)፤ 4. ትዕዛዛዊ ዓ.ነገር (Kiita)።

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Dummatetha giddon de7iya issipetethaa (kochcha, doona, ammano, woga bonchchetethaa) nabbaboninne haasayan akeekana.

learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ቀአለ ኪፊሌተ (ሱንꬂ፣ ፔእሾ፣ ሱንቅቆ፣ ፔእቆ፣ ደብቦꬆ/ሲጌꬆንኔ ገሴꬆ) ሻአክኪ ጎዔትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: የጎፋኛ የቃል ክፍሎችን (ስም፣ ግስ፣ ቅጽል፣ ተውሳከ ግስ፣ መስተዋድድና አያያዥ) ለይተው ይጠቀማሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Identify and use the major Gofatho parts of speech: Nouns (Sunthi), Verbs (Peesho), Adjectives (Sunqqo), Adverbs (Peeqo), and Adpositions/Conjunctions (Dabbotho/Sigetho & Gasetho).

 ሺቁወን ዴንድዲደ ቆፈተፕፔ ነምዕዓንꬆይ፣ ዱምመ ዱምመ ዴሬቴꬃአ ጊድዶን

ሺቁወን ዴንድዲደበተፕፔ ሄእꬓንꬆይ፣ ሀቺ ገሶ ከዎይ ጊዲን ኢየ ገርስሰን ጊዲዲ

ገዴ ከዎቴꬃአ አይሱወአስ ጊዲን ገዴ ዲቻአ ቦልለ ሜቶ ሜꬍꬊየበአቲ ጉኡጥጠነ 
ሜለንኔ ደልግገ ኮቻተን ኡኡገ ጠንጥጠ ኮችቻ አሰቲ ቆሄትቶንነ ሜለ ዎገ ኬሶን 
ኡብበ አሰቲክከ ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒሺን ኢስሲፔቴꬃይ ዴዔይስሰ እሪዲ ዬሌተይ ከዎ ኦኦሶ 
ፖሎ ቦልለ ጊዲን ገዴ ዴሬቴꬃአ ሰሮቴꬃአ ቦልለ ቆሄይ ደልግጎንነ ሜለ ተመርስሲዲ 
ኦጌ ቤሶን ሚንꬂስ። ከሴ አአꬍꬊደ ዎዴተን ጊዲንክከ ኑ ዴሬ አሰአ ዱኡስሰ ሀኖተአ 
ቤዒየአ ዎዴ ዴሬቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒሺን ኢስሲፔቴꬃይ ዴዔይስሰ 
መርክከንድዶቲ መልሎኦሶነ። ሀረ በግገረ ዴሬ አሰይ ዱምመቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ 
ኢስሲፔቴꬃአ ጎዓአ ሎይꬂ እሮንነ ጊሾ ተመርስሶኒንኔ እሬትቲደ በይረ ጊዲደ አሰተ 
ዞሪየ እክኮንነ ኢጦይ ደሮ ዎዴ ዴሬቴꬃአስ ሻአኬቴꬂንኔ ሲኢቆ ꬋዮን ዎሊፕፔ 
ዱኡጥጠነ መለ ኦኦꬂየ ጊተ ኢኢተ ሜእዜ ጊዲየይስሰ ጊዲሺን ሀዕዒ ዎዴ ዬሌተይ 
ዱምመቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዴዒየ ኢስሲፔቴꬃአ መአረን ሚንꬂ ሜእዜቲክኮ ደሮ ሎዕዖ። 
ፑልትቶይ ጎጊሌ፤ ጊኢጊሲደይ፣ ሞክኮንኔ ሞጎሴ።
ሜእዜ 3
ኢ። ከአልሊየ ኦይሾተ ኒበአቢየአን ዜምፕፒዲ ዘአሪቴ።
1። ዴሬቴꬃን ዱምመቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዴዒየአ ኢስሲፔቴꬃአ ቡቂየበአቲ አይበ አይቤእ?
2። ከዎቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ዎይ ኢስሲ ሄእረን ዎረንዚየ አሰቲ ወአኒ ሜꬌትቶኦነአ?
3። ዱምመ ዱምመ አምመኖ እቆተቲ ዎሊ ጊድዶን ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒሺን ሲኢቆቴꬃን 
ዴዓነው አይ አይ ኦኦሴትተነው ቤስሲኢ?
4። ኢስሲፔቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ሜቶይ ሜꬌትቲኮ ጊኢጊሰነው ደንድደዔይ ኦኦኔእ?
5። ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃን ሂንትቴ መተ ለግጌቲ ዎሊረ ፐለመ ሜꬍꬊክኮ ወአተኔእ?
6። ደአስሰ ኢስሱወን ሺኢቁወን ዴንድዲደ ኮይሮ ቆፈይ አይቤእ?
7። ደአስሰ ሄእꬓ ቆፈአ ቀንꬃን ፐአትቲቴ።

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Tophphiya dere asaa giddon medhettanaw dandda7iya dummatetha qommotape bertteti: kochchata (ethnic), doona, ammano, guta (regional), woga, taarikenne polotika dummatethata gidoosona.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ቶጵጪየ ዴሬ አሰአ ጊድዶን ሜꬌትተነው ደንድደዒየ ዱምመቴꬃ ቆምሞተፔ ቤርትቴቲ፦ ኮችቻተ (እꬅኒጭ)፣ ዶኦነ፣ አምመኖ፣ ጉተ (ሬጊኦነል)፣ ዎገ፣ ተአሪኬንኔ ፖሎቲከ ዱምመቴꬃተ ጊዶኦሶነ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ሕዝቦች መካከል ከሚታዩት የብዝኃነት ዓይነቶች ዋና ዋናዎቹ፦ የብሔር፣ የቋንቋ፣ የሃይማኖት፣ የአካባቢ፣ የባህል፣ የታሪክና የፖለቲካ ልዩነቶች ናቸው።
key_aligned_sentences.english: The primary dimensions of diversity among the peoples of Ethiopia include ethnicity, language, religion, region, culture, history, and politics.

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Nu gaden Isilaama ammaniya asatinne Kiristtaane ammano kaalliya asati daro laythas wol bonchchidinne wol siiqidi issippe de7idosona.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ገዴን ኢሲለአመ አምመኒየ አሰቲንኔ ኪሪስትተአኔ አምመኖ ከአልሊየ አሰቲ ደሮ ለይꬃስ ዎል ቦንችቺዲንኔ ዎል ሲኢቂዲ ኢስሲፕፔ ዴዒዶሶነ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: በአገራችን የእስልምና እና የክርስትና ሃይማኖት ተከታዮች ለብዙ ዘመናት እርስ በርስ ተከባብረውና ተዋደው አብረው ኖረዋል።
key_aligned_sentences.english: In our country, Muslims and Christians have lived together in mutual respect and love for centuries.

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Full Dialogue between Morggaama and Gardda (4.B Haasaya, pp. 30–31, by Mokkonna M.): Morggaama: 'Hintte heera asaa issipetethay ay melee?' Gardda: 'La ta new ay odada ay aggoo! Deretethaa giddon daro dummatethay de7ishin wol dandda7on dumma dumma gahettiya bessatan: wudiyaan, giyaan, woosa keethaan, yaaganoninne h.h.mela bessatan dumma dumma metoti medhetteyssata dandda7idi qaari bessonna woli kammidi de7oosona... "Darana deriyan heedzay daggi uyees" giyaa tossiya mela wolli siiqoninne dandda7an duussay keehipe lo77ope attin iita gidenna.'
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ሞርግገአመ አንድ ገርድደ (4።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕፕ። 30–31፣ ብይ ሞክኮንነ ም።)፦ ሞርግገአመ፦ 'ሂንትቴ ሄእረ አሰአ ኢስሲፔቴꬃይ አይ ሜሌእ?' ገርድደ፦ 'ለ ተ ኔው አይ ኦደደ አይ አግጎኦ! ዴሬቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ደሮ ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒሺን ዎል ደንድደዖን ዱምመ ዱምመ ገሄትቲየ ቤስሰተን፦ ዉዲየአን፣ ጊየአን፣ ዎኦሰ ኬእꬃአን፣ የአገኖኒንኔ ህ።ህ።ሜለ ቤስሰተን ዱምመ ዱምመ ሜቶቲ ሜꬌትቴይስሰተ ደንድደዒዲ ቀአሪ ቤስሶንነ ዎሊ ከምሚዲ ዴዖኦሶነ።።። "ደረነ ዴሪየን ሄእꬓይ ደግጊ ኡዬእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሲየ ሜለ ዎልሊ ሲኢቆኒንኔ ደንድደዓን ዱኡስሰይ ኬእሂፔ ሎዕዖፔ አትቲን ኢኢተ ጊዴንነ።'
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: በሞርጋማ እና በጋርዳ መካከል የተደረገ ምልልስ (ገጽ 30–31)፦ ሞርጋማ ስለ አካባቢው ሕዝብ አንድነት ሲጠይቅ፣ ጋርዳ በግጦሽ ቦታ (wudiyaan)፣ በገበያ (giyaan)፣ በጸሎት ቤትና በሠርግ ላይ በመቻቻልና በመከባበር አብረው እንደሚኖሩ 'በሚያድግ አገር ሦስት ሰው ተጋግዞ ይጠጣል' በሚለው ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር ያስረዳዋል።
haasaya_dialogues.english: Dialogue between Morggaama and Gardda (pp. 30–31): Discussing how diverse communities maintain unity in grazing lands, markets, places of worship, and weddings through tolerance (woli dandda7o), mutual respect (wolli bonchetetha), and equality (gina xeelo).

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Goofatho Qaala Kifileta (5 Parts of Speech, 4.F Qawosa, pp. 35–38): (1) Sunthi (Nouns: adde, macca, na7a, keethe, boori), (2) Peesho (Verbs: ma, imma, immis, bis, ekkis, oothis, bees, maana), (3) Sunqqo (Adjectives modifying nouns: wancco boori, gooba tamaare), (4) Peeqo (Adverbs modifying verbs: loythi, ubbara, zine, wontta, eeson), (5) Dabbotho: Sigetho (Postpositions: mela/-da 'like', bolla, garssa) & Gasetho (Conjunctions: -nne 'and', shin 'but', woy 'or', gisho 'because').
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ቀአለ ኪፊሌተ (5 ፐርትስ ኦፍ ስፔእች፣ 4።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕፕ። 35–38)፦ (1) ሱንꬂ (ኖኡንስ፦ አድዴ፣ መጭጨ፣ ነዓ፣ ኬእꬄ፣ ቦኦሪ)፣ (2) ፔእሾ (ቬርብስ፦ መ፣ ኢምመ፣ ኢምሚስ፣ ቢስ፣ እክኪስ፣ ኦኦꬂስ፣ ቤእስ፣ መአነ)፣ (3) ሱንቅቆ (አድጄጭቲቬስ ሞዲፍዪንግ ኖኡንስ፦ ወንጭጮ ቦኦሪ፣ ጎኦበ ተመአሬ)፣ (4) ፔእቆ (አድቬርብስ ሞዲፍዪንግ ቬርብስ፦ ሎይꬂ፣ ኡብበረ፣ ዚኔ፣ ዎንትተ፣ እእሶን)፣ (5) ደብቦꬆ፦ ሲጌꬆ (ፖስትፖሲቲኦንስ፦ ሜለ/-ደ 'ሊኬ'፣ ቦልለ፣ ገርስሰ) & ገሴꬆ (ጮንጁንጭቲኦንስ፦ -ንኔ 'አንድ'፣ ሺን 'ቡት'፣ ዎይ 'ኦር'፣ ጊሾ 'ቤጨኡሴ')።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: አምስቱ የጎፋኛ የቃል ክፍሎች (4.F Qawosa፣ ገጽ 35–38)፦ (1) ስም (Sunthi)፣ (2) ግስ (Peesho)፣ (3) ቅጽል (Sunqqo)፣ (4) ተውሳከ ግስ (Peeqo)፣ (5) መስተዋድድና አያያዥ (Dabbotho፦ Sigethonne Gasetho)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: The Five Parts of Speech in Gofatho (4.F Qawosa, pp. 35–38): Nouns (Sunthi), Verbs (Peesho), Adjectives (Sunqqo), Adverbs (Peeqo), and Function Words (Dabbotho: Postpositions 'Sigetho' and Conjunctions 'Gasetho').

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: በሚያድግ (በሚበለጽግ) አገር ሦስት ሰው ተጋግዞ ይጠጣል።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: In a community destined to prosper, three people share and drink together in harmony.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ድሀ ተጉዞ (ለፍቶ) ይከተላል፤ ሀብታም በልቶ ይከተላል።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: The poor person follows by trudging along; the rich person follows after eating.

meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_latin: Meeze 6 (4.F Qawosa, p. 38): Identify parts of speech in sentences: 3. 'Darcci ubba wode shiiqotan pa qofaa eeson shiishees' -> Peesho: shiishees; Peeqo: eeson. 5. 'Bazoy zine Bulqqipe wancco boori shammis' -> Sunqqo: wancco. 7. 'Mogoseynne Geetachoy Goofatho maxaafe xaafoosona' -> Gasetho: -nne.
meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 6 (4።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕ። 38)፦ ኢዴንቲፍይ ፐርትስ ኦፍ ስፔእች ኢን ሴንቴንጬስ፦ 3። 'ደርጭጪ ኡብበ ዎዴ ሺኢቆተን ፐ ቆፈአ እእሶን ሺኢሼእስ' -> ፔእሾ፦ ሺኢሼእስ፤ ፔእቆ፦ እእሶን። 5። 'በዞይ ዚኔ ቡልቅቂፔ ወንጭጮ ቦኦሪ ሻምሚስ' -> ሱንቅቆ፦ ወንጭጮ። 7። 'ሞጎሴይንኔ ጌእተቾይ ጎኦፈꬆ መጠአፌ ጠአፎኦሶነ' -> ገሴꬆ፦ -ንኔ።
meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 6 (ሰዋስው፣ ገጽ 38)፦ በዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የቃል ክፍሎችን መለየት፦ 3. ግስ (Peesho) = shiishees፤ 5. ቅጽል (Sunqqo) = wancco፤ 7. አያያዥ (Gasetho) = -nne።
meeze_student_exercises.english: Exercise 6 (Part-of-Speech Identification, p. 38): 3. Verb = shiishees, Adverb = eeson; 5. Adjective = wancco; 7. Conjunction = -nne.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: Gofatho Oral Literature (Dual-Edged Proverbs, Folktales, Riddles, and Poetic Duels)

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Dumma dumma bila odata (tosseta, hayseta, sedhemenkketanne qan77isheta) dummatethaa shaakkana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ዱምመ ዱምመ ቢለ ኦደተ (ቶስሴተ፣ ሀይሴተ፣ ሴꬌሜንክኬተንኔ ቀንዕዒሼተ) ዱምመቴꬃአ ሻአክከነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: የተለያዩ የሥነ-ቃል ዘውጎችን (ምሳሌያዊ ንግግሮች፣ ተረቶች፣ እንቆቅልሾችና ቃንጪሼዎች) ልዩነት ይለያሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Distinguish and analyze Gofatho proverbs (tosse), folktales (hayse), riddles (sedhemenkke), and poetic duels (qan77ishe).

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Tossey Goofa wogan nam77u bagga oco mashshada (nashshishe vs. borishe) maaddeyssa mallan qonccisana.

learning_objectives.amharic: ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር (Tosse) በጎፋ ባህል እንደ ሁለት አፍ ቢላዋ (በአንድ በኩል እያሞገሰ፣ በሌላ በኩል እየተቸ) እንዴት እንደሚያገለግል በምሳሌ ያብራራሉ።

 ³ Sedhemenkke:-
Sedhemenkey Goofa dere asati qoppi zaaranaw qofa dalggiso wolqqi de7iya bila 
oda qommo. Wothishekka: sedhemenkkee? Giikko, zaaraaddey gaare gees. 
Hessappe woy hara miishetanne medosata qassika dozata gidin hara koyidabaas 
wothees. Dandda7ikko zaares; hankkoode gade immees. Zaaraaddey eronna ixxiko, 
ichashu toho paaccana qaadi imettees. Haray odanaw dandda7enna. Odana aazikko 
yallo ma77a geetettidi ammaatettees. Zaaruwaas gam77iko, wothaaddey “Ta na7aa 
dulley shuuqqees” gees.Hessika ellesisossa.
Wurssethan ichchashu kunthiya wode, wothaaddey (“Ta na7ay para bolla pastti ne 
na7ay xinqilo bolla cistti; ta na7ay xamaata mixilttees ne na7ay giishshi mixilttees”) 
gi ceeqetti simmidi, “odoo aggoo” gi oychees. Zaaraaddey “oda gaana maati baawa” 
giikko, “oda giya booraa imma geetettiya gisho odanay agganay ne shene” gees. 
Hessappe guye odees. Kase zaaraaddey guuthi soskki aggida gidikko, “kuu…kuu”; 
“ta gadey taakko; taani kase hoshisas” gidi mootettees.

10ꬆ ኪፊሌ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ

 “አ” “ብ”
1። አጌእነ የምብበረ አ። ቦኦꬃ ጠምዕዓ እከ ዬእሆ ለአሰ

3። ፒሊ ፒዉ ጭ። ኔ ሻርቅቂየአን ደንቅቆ
4። ቀንዕዒሼይ ቀሼእክኮ ለጌእ ድ። ዎዴꬃፔ ቂተ ለአጭጨ
5። ቦሎል ገደ ቦልለ ዎጥጠአ እ። ዎንትቶ ኔዉ በሌእ
6። ሻአፈን ሻኮ ፍ። ቀጪኒ ሀርፕፐ ለጌእ

8። ዎኦ ወሌእ ህ። አጀአጅጂየአ በንነከአ
9። ዎለይꬃፔ ዎጠ በዕዓአ ኢ። ለአቅቀ ሙሌይ ኔዉ ሺንቅቄእ
10። ዎጥጠሼ ዎጥጠሼ ዎለይꬂ ገክከ ጅ። ፒትቲደ ኦልሌን ሊዉሁ

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Tossey Goofa wogan nam77u bagga oco mashshada issi allalles woy issi asas de7iya kandduwas minonne dol7a miyiyaa gathi qonccisiya wolqqi de7ees.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ቶስሴይ ጎኦፈ ዎገን ነምዕዑ በግገ ኦጮ መሽሻደ ኢስሲ አልለልሌስ ዎይ ኢስሲ አሰስ ዴዒየ ከንድዱወስ ሚኖንኔ ዶልዓ ሚዪየአ ገꬂ ቆንጭጪሲየ ዎልቅቂ ዴዔእስ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር (Tosse) በጎፋ ባህል እንደ ሁለት አፍ ቢላዋ የአንድን ጉዳይ ወይም ሰው ጠንካራና ደካማ ጎን አጣምሮ የመግለጽ ኃይል አለው።
key_aligned_sentences.english: In Gofatho culture, a proverb (tosse) is like a double-edged knife capable of illuminating both the strong and weak sides of any matter or person.

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Asara Go7ettidi Haysetidabaa (p. 43): Beni issi heeran issi azalla adde de7eyssi... pa manqqotethiw yilotidi biraata miishe wale, kaltta, beexe ekkidi gadha gelis; qeexi kessida gadiyan badalanne leehe wonddo wooqisidi beni attida machees zaari cima yeddin qinxxi qiphphi gada soo yasu.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: አሰረ ጎዔትቲዲ ሀይሴቲደበአ (ፕ። 43)፦ ቤኒ ኢስሲ ሄእረን ኢስሲ አዘልለ አድዴ ዴዔይስሲ።።። ፐ መንቅቆቴꬂው ዪሎቲዲ ቢረአተ ሚኢሼ ወሌ፣ ከልትተ፣ ቤእጤ እክኪዲ ገꬋ ጌሊስ፤ ቄእጢ ኬስሲደ ገዲየን በደለንኔ ሌእሄ ዎንድዶ ዎኦቂሲዲ ቤኒ አትቲደ መቼእስ ዘአሪ ጪመ ዬድዲን ቂንጥጢ ቂጵጪ ገደ ሶኦ የሱ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: የተረት ምሳሌ (ገጽ 43)፦ በድሮ ጊዜ አንድ ሰነፍ ሰው ሚስቱ በድህነቱ ምክንያት ትታው ወደ እናቷ ቤት ስትሄድ፣ ተቆጭቶ ማጭድ፣ መጥረቢያና ዶማ ይዞ ወደ ቆላ ወርዶ መሬት መንጥሮ በቆሎና ማሽላ አብቅሎ ሲበለጽግ፣ ሚስቱ በደስታ ወደ ቤቷ ተመለሰች።
key_aligned_sentences.english: Folktale of the Reformed Husband (p. 43): Abandoned by his wife due to his laziness and poverty, a man takes up his sickle, axe, and hoe, clears lowland fields, grows abundant maize and sorghum, and welcomes his wife back in joy.

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkke & Qan77ishe Interactive Performance Dialogues (pp. 44–47): Includes the 5-guess rule in Sedhemenkke, the boast formula ('Ta na7ay para bolla pastti ne na7ay xinqilo bolla cistti; ta na7ay xamaata mixilttees ne na7ay giishshi mixilttees'), and Qan77ishe dialogues between Doli & Baloy and Cumppe & Cula.
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬ & ቀንዕዒሼ ኢንቴረጭቲቬ ፔርፎርመንጬ ዲአሎጉእስ (ፕፕ። 44–47)፦ ኢንጭሉዴስ ꬄ 5-ጉእስስ ሩሌ ኢን ሴꬌሜንክኬ፣ ꬄ ቦአስት ፎርሙለ ('ተ ነዓይ ፐረ ቦልለ ፐስትቲ ኔ ነዓይ ጢንቂሎ ቦልለ ጪስትቲ፤ ተ ነዓይ ጠመአተ ሚጢልትቴእስ ኔ ነዓይ ጊኢሽሺ ሚጢልትቴእስ')፣ አንድ ቀንዕዒሼ ዲአሎጉእስ ቤትዌእን ዶሊ & በሎይ አንድ ጩምፕፔ & ጩለ።
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: የእንቆቅልሽና የቃንጪሼ የተግባር ምልልሶች (ገጽ 44–47)፦ በእንቆቅልሽ መላሹ 5 ጊዜ ከሞከረ በኋላ አገር ሲሰጥ ጠያቂው የሚፎክርበት ሥርዓትና የዶሊና ባሎይ እንዲሁም የጩምፔና ጩላ የቃንጪሼ ምልልስ።
haasaya_dialogues.english: Riddle and Poetic Duel Performance Dialogues (pp. 44–47): Full ceremonial dialogue formulas for Sedhemenkke (including the 5-attempt rule and victory boast) and Qan77ishe couplet exchanges.

qabirshshe_ooratha_qaala_vocabulary.english: bush-knife/sickle, axe, and digging hoe (traditional iron farming tools)

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Antithetical & Parallel Structure in Gofatho Proverbs (pp. 40–42): Proverbs pair semantic opposites (Na7a–cima, macca–attuma, manqqo–dure, zambbo–azalla, booza–cincca, kalo–kosha, elleso–gam77o, mal77o–camo, siiqo–ixo) using balanced medial converbs (-in, -idi).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: አንቲꬄቲጨል & ፐረልሌል ስትሩጭቱሬ ኢን ጎፈꬆ ፕሮቬርብስ (ፕፕ። 40–42)፦ ፕሮቬርብስ ፐኢር ሴመንቲጭ ኦፕፖሲቴስ (ነዓ–ጪመ፣ መጭጨ–አትቱመ፣ መንቅቆ–ዱሬ፣ ዘምብቦ–አዘልለ፣ ቦኦዘ–ጪንጭጨ፣ ከሎ–ኮሻ፣ እልሌሶ–ገምዕዖ፣ መልዕዖ–ጨሞ፣ ሲኢቆ–ኢጦ) ኡሲንግ በለንጬድ ሜዲአል ጮንቬርብስ (-ኢን፣ -ኢዲ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: በጎፋኛ ምሳሌያዊ ንግግሮች ውስጥ ያለው የተቃራኒ ቃላትና የሐረጎች ምጣኔ (ገጽ 40–42)፦ ልጅ-ሽማግሌ፣ ድሀ-ሀብታም፣ ታታሪ-ሰነፍ፣ ጥጋብ-ረሃብ፣ ችኮላ-መዘግየት፣ ፍቅር-ጥላቻ።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Parallel and Antithetical Syntax in Proverbs (pp. 40–42): Pairing contrasting lexical poles across balanced clauses.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ጥሩ ነገር ከቡቃያው (ከጅምሩ) ያምራል።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Goodness blossoms right from the young shoot.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Lo77oy wadhdhin sakkenna; lomppi qoommin qum7enna.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ሎዕዖይ ወꬍꬊን ሰክኬንነ፤ ሎምፕፒ ቆኦምሚን ቁምዔንነ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ጥሩ ነገር ቢወድቅ አያምም፣ አጥብቀው ቢይዙት አይጎዳም።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: What is good does not hurt when it falls, nor spoil when held close.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ከጥሩ ነገር ስር እንከን (ጉድለት) አይጠፋም።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Beneath a good exterior, a flaw may lurk.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: በውጩ ማራኪ፣ በውስጡ ግን እሾህ/አስቸጋሪ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Outwardly attractive, inwardly thorny.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Iiti iita wode ashshees; Iiti ishassa; Haatha iitinne aayi iiti baawa.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢቲ ኢኢተ ዎዴ አሽሼእስ፤ ኢኢቲ ኢሻስሰ፤ ሀአꬃ ኢኢቲንኔ አአዪ ኢኢቲ በአወ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ክፉ ለክፉ ቀን ይደርሳል፤ የውኃ ክፉና የእናት ክፉ የለም።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Even something harsh saves you in hard times; there is no bad water or bad mother.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Iiti iissees, curqqi shaallees; Iitabay zin77i qakkees; Ixxiyaa imathi laappun qamma aqees.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ኢኢቲ ኢኢስሴእስ፣ ጩርቅቂ ሻአልሌእስ፤ ኢኢተበይ ዚንዕዒ ቀክኬእስ፤ ኢጥጢየአ ኢመꬂ ለአፕፑን ቀምመ አቄእስ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ክፋት ያጋጫል፣ ጭቃ ያቆሽሻል፤ ክፉ ሥራ እንቅልፍ ይነሳል፤ የተጠላ እንግዳ ሰባት ሌሊት ያድራል።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Malice ruins relationships as mud stains; evil deeds ruin sleep; an unwelcome guest stays seven nights.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Iras gelidi kaho gishees; Care wozanan yedhdhin oqane uloy sakkees; Yessi be7i yeekkees, missi be7i bookkees.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ኢረስ ጌሊዲ ከሆ ጊሼእስ፤ ጨሬ ዎዘነን ዬꬍꬊን ኦቀኔ ኡሎይ ሰክኬእስ፤ ዬስሲ ቤዒ ዬእክኬእስ፣ ሚስሲ ቤዒ ቦኦክኬእስ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ከዝናብ ሸሽቶ ወደ ዶፍ መግባት፤ ቂም በልብ ሲያዝ ውስጡን ያሳምማል፤ ሰው ሲያለቅስ አይቶ ማልቀስ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Fleeing rain into a downpour; stepping on a thorn in the heart makes the stomach ache; crying merely because others cry.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Paraa dirguwaan harey hayqqees; Diccana na7i gufanthin diccees; Godaa ammanida dorssiyaa goynaa karen ayssawus; Ellesoy gam7on gathees; Ammano mashshay tiriyaan me7ees; Eqqi caddanaw hokki zuummees.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ፐረአ ዲርጉወአን ሀሬይ ሀይቅቄእስ፤ ዲጭጨነ ነዒ ጉፈንꬂን ዲጭጬእስ፤ ጎደአ አምመኒደ ዶርስሲየአ ጎይነአ ከሬን አይስሰዉስ፤ እልሌሶይ ገምዖን ገꬄእስ፤ አምመኖ መሽሻይ ቲሪየአን ሜዔእስ፤ እቅቂ ጨድደነው ሆክኪ ዙኡምሜእስ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: በፈረሶች ግርግር አህያ ይሞታል፤ የሚያድግ ልጅ እየተደናቀፈ ያድጋል፤ ጌታዋን የተማመነች በግ ላቷን ውጭ ታሳድራለች፤ ችኮላ ወደ መዘግየት ያደርሳል፤ የእምነት ቢላዋ በጉበት ውስጥ ይሰበራል፤ ቆሞ ለመውጋት ጎንበስ ብሎ መጠጋት።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: In the stampede of horses the donkey dies; a growing child grows by stumbling; the sheep that trusts its master leaves its tail outside; haste leads to delay; a knife of betrayal breaks in the liver; to strike standing, one first crouches.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkke (p. 45): (1) Na7iyaa hello guppaws aayiyaa tira harggaws -> Tuutenne udula (pestle & mortar); (2) Bollay tama garssay tama giddoy shemppo ashshiyaaba -> Difo daabbo (baked bread); (3) Kareetha miiziya bootha marata kaalethawus -> Ayfe tukke sinenne zhabana (black coffee pot & white cups).
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬ (ፕ። 45)፦ (1) ነዒየአ ሄልሎ ጉፕፐውስ አአዪየአ ቲረ ሀርግገውስ -> ቱኡቴንኔ ኡዱለ (ፔስትሌ & ሞርተር)፤ (2) ቦልለይ ተመ ገርስሰይ ተመ ጊድዶይ ሼምፕፖ አሽሺየአበ -> ዲፎ ደአብቦ (በኬድ ብሬአድ)፤ (3) ከሬእꬃ ሚኢዚየ ቦኦꬃ መረተ ከአሌꬃዉስ -> አይፌ ቱክኬ ሲኔንኔ ዣበነ (ብለጭክ ጮፍፌእ ፖት & ውሂቴ ጩፕስ)።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: እንቆቅልሾች (ገጽ 45)፦ (1) ልጅቷ ስትዘል እናትየው ደረቷን ያማታል -> ሙቀጫና ዘነዘና፤ (2) ላዩ እሳት ታቹ እሳት መሃሉ ነፍስ የሚያድን -> ድፎ ዳቦ፤ (3) ጥቁር ላም ነጭ ጥጃዎችን ትመራለች -> ጀበናና ሲኒዎች።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Riddles (p. 45): (1) Daughter jumps while mother's chest aches -> Pestle and mortar; (2) Fire above, fire below, life-saving food inside -> Baked difo bread; (3) Black cow leading white calves -> Black clay coffee pot and white cups.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Qan77ishe (pp. 46–47): (1) Ta booraa Shannoy shaafi qocees -> Shaaqanchoy nena gelanaw huuphe pixees; (2) Qalqqaaluwada qaamma -> Qaalichaa nagiriitaada guumma; (3) Woxxashe woxxashe wolaythi gakka -> Harggashe harggashe meqethi atta.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: ቀንዕዒሼ (ፕፕ። 46–47)፦ (1) ተ ቦኦረአ ሻንኖይ ሻአፊ ቆጬእስ -> ሻአቀንቾይ ኔነ ጌለነው ሁኡጴ ፒጤእስ፤ (2) ቀልቅቀአሉወደ ቀአምመ -> ቀአሊቻአ ነጊሪኢተአደ ጉኡምመ፤ (3) ዎጥጠሼ ዎጥጠሼ ዎለይꬂ ገክከ -> ሀርግገሼ ሀርግገሼ ሜቄꬂ አትተ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ቃንጪሼ (ገጽ 46–47)፦ (1) ኮርማዬ ሻኖ ወንዝ ይመታል -> እጮኛሽ አንቺን ለማግባት ፀጉሩን ያበጥራል፤ (2) እንደ ቆዳ ቃሚ -> እንደ ቃልቻ ነጋሪት አጉረምርሚ፤ (3) እየሮጥክ ወላይታ ድረስ -> እየታመምክ አጥንት ቅር።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Qan77ishe Couplets (pp. 46–47): Traditional rhyming verbal duels.

meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_latin: Meeze 5 (Qan77ishe Dabbotho, p. 47): Match Qan77ishe prompts in Column A with traditional rhyming responses in Column B: 4. Qan77ishey qasheekko lagee -> F. Qacini harppa lagee; 6. Shaafan shako -> C. Ne sharqqiyaan danqqo; 7. Qalqqalaada qaamma -> B. Qaalicha nagiriitaada guumma; 10. Woxxashe woxxashe wolaythi gakka -> G. Harggashe harggashe meqethi atta.
meeze_student_exercises.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 5 (ቀንዕዒሼ ደብቦꬆ፣ ፕ። 47)፦ መትች ቀንዕዒሼ ፕሮምፕትስ ኢን ጮሉምን አ ዊꬅ ትረዲቲኦነል ርህይሚንግ ሬስፖንሴስ ኢን ጮሉምን ብ፦ 4። ቀንዕዒሼይ ቀሼእክኮ ለጌእ -> ፍ። ቀጪኒ ሀርፕፐ ለጌእ፤ 6። ሻአፈን ሻኮ -> ጭ። ኔ ሻርቅቂየአን ደንቅቆ፤ 7። ቀልቅቀለአደ ቀአምመ -> ብ። ቀአሊቻ ነጊሪኢተአደ ጉኡምመ፤ 10። ዎጥጠሼ ዎጥጠሼ ዎለይꬂ ገክከ -> ግ። ሀርግገሼ ሀርግገሼ ሜቄꬂ አትተ።
meeze_student_exercises.amharic: መልመጃ 5 (ቃንጪሼ ማዛመድ፣ ገጽ 47)፦ በ'A' ስር የቀረቡትን የቃንጪሼ መነሻዎች በ'B' ስር ካሉት ምላሾች ጋር ማዛመድ።
meeze_student_exercises.english: Exercise 5 (Qan77ishe Matching, p. 47): Match each traditional Qan77ishe opening line with its canonical rhyming response.

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Dondzatas gade woga saro medhon de7iya gishaaddetethaa (Dubbusha, Gozdda, Shimaagille, Jaarsa, Gudumaale, Woma, Kicha, Mora) paattana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ዶንꬓተስ ገዴ ዎገ ሰሮ ሜꬎን ዴዒየ ጊሻአድዴቴꬃአ (ዱብቡሻ፣ ጎዝድደ፣ ሺመአጊልሌ፣ ጀአርሰ፣ ጉዱመአሌ፣ ዎመ፣ ኪቻ፣ ሞረ) ፐአትተነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: ሽማግሌዎች በባህላዊ የዕርቅና የሰላም ግንባታ ውስጥ ያላቸውን ሚና (ዱቡሻ፣ ጎዝዳ፣ ሽማግሌ፣ ጃርሳ፣ ጉዱማሌ፣ ወማ፣ ኪቻ፣ ሞራ) ያብራራሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Analyze indigenous Ethiopian and Gofatho elder peacebuilding institutions (Dubbusha, Gozdda, Shimaagille, Jaarsa, Gudumaale, Woma, Kicha, Mora).

learning_objectives.gofatho_latin: Buzo dabddaabbenne ooso dabddaabbe xaafana; pinniyaa peeshonne pinnonna peesho shaakkana.
learning_objectives.gofatho_fidel: ቡዞ ደብድደአብቤንኔ ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤ ጠአፈነ፤ ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾንኔ ፒንኖንነ ፔእሾ ሻአክከነ።
learning_objectives.amharic: የግል ደብዳቤና የሥራ ደብዳቤ ይጽፋሉ፤ ተሻጋሪ ግስና (Pinniyaa peesho) ኢ-ተሻጋሪ ግስን (Pinnonna peesho) ይለያሉ።
learning_objectives.english: Write personal and official business/application letters and distinguish transitive verbs (pinniyaa peesho) from intransitive verbs (pinnonna peesho).
