 6.B. Haasaya
Meeze 2
I. Kaallidi Shiiqida Kaarata Bolla Palamite.
1. Issoy issuwa bonchcheyssan woy qoheyssan benttiya go7i de7iiye baawee?
2. Asi wolira issippe meyssinne uyeyssi l77ooye iitee? Giya qfan.
3. Bayrata bonchchoy lo77ooye iitee? Giyaa qofaan.
4. Gade wogan giigisoy saynsse ogen giigisora gineeye attiya hanoti de7ii? Giya 
qofaan.
 6.C. Nabbabo
I. Kaallidi Shiiqida Nibaabiya Sirphphan Nabbabidi Qanthara Issi Daassi 
Xaafite.
Dondzatas Gade Woga Saro Medhon De7iya Gishaddetethaa.
Daro wodeppe doomidi issi heera dere asay dumma dumma medhettiyaa kachchata 
dhaysonne teqetha oosota oothishe gam77is. Ubba heerankka gade wogan saro 
naagiso wogay heeraape heeran dummatees. He oosoy gaden woy heera wogaadan, 
dabbotetha gahetethaadan, ooso keetha meeziyaadaninne h.h.melatan katidi 
polettees (Macfarlane, 2007). Ha qantha adarssoy dondzata gade wogan saro medho: 
Tophphiyaan, Dugeha Tophphiyaaninne nu heera Goofan oosettida oosota shishi 
oykkees. 
Dondzata gade wogan saro medho oosotape koyroy, gade dethan woy Tophphiyaan 
oosettiyaa oosota. Hessika, beni benkko laythape doommidi Fitaha Negestte 
geetettiyaa kawotethaa wodepe doommidi issi issi buzo asata gidin heeray heeraara 
cugan medhdhiya kachchata gade wogan giigisanaw oda bila eriyaa dondzati 
doorettoosona. Hessa mela doorettidi giigisiyaa dondzati Amaara heeran Shimaagille, 
Oroomo heeran Gadaa, Sidaama heeran Gudumaalee h.h.mela geetitti erettiyeyssati 
Tophphiya gade wogaan saro medhdhiyaa cugatape beettiyaa malla gidees.
Baryata giigiso oosotape nam77anthoy, gade wogan saro medho Dugeha Tophphiya 
kililen oosettiyaa oosota gidees. Ha kililey Tophphiyaan 3 tho dalgga kilile, daro 
wogaawatinne daro doonaawatikka hara kilileyssatape dariyayssara gahettidi

45
Tamaare Maxaafe
nu kililen aawata gade wogan saro medho hanotay oyddu dethatan shaahettees. 
Hessatikka, xanxxa woy kochcha kaappota (clan leaders’ councils), cima kaappo 
(elders councils), woga meeze cugata (ritual practitioners) nne deriyaa shiishiya 
cugata (public gatherings) geetettidi dumma dumma heeratan dumma dumma 
hanotatan sarotethaa medhdhishe gam77idosonanne medhdhishe de7oosona. Ha 
ooso meezeta nu kililiyaan xeelliyaa wode: Burji heeran, Woma geetettiya woga 
cimati, Baskketon Baalabbaate geetettiyaa cugati, Guraagen Kicha, Konson Mora, 
Gamoninne Goofan Dubbushanne h.h.melatan sunthettidi ha77i wode pirdda imoy 
woy giigiso hanotay medhettanaape sinthe oosettishe gam77idabaane ha77ika hankko 
heeray ay meleekko erettonna ixxikokka nu heeran Gamoninne Goofan dondzati 
ayba kachchi medhettikokka giigiso ooso oothishe gam77idosona woy de7idosona. 
Gamo cimati saro medho ooson erettidi Tophphiya pudeha shewa Burayo Woradan 
Gamo yeleta asata giddoninne Burayo dere asata giddon medhettida wolqqaama 
kachchata Gamo cimati panttaw de7iya wolqqaama bonchchotethaaninne 
eratethaan go7ettidi woranzoy diccishe boonna mela maata oykki nayta woossidi 
irxxisidi giigisidayssinne Goofan qassi, dhoqqa dethan woy kilileninne Tunggan 
de7iyaa Goofa yeleta kawo oosanchata giddoninne Goofa sima cugata woy Gozdda 
geetettiyaa cugata giddon medhettida polotikara gahettida kachaa nu dere cimati 
gelonna soo gelidi giigisidayssi beettiyaa malla. 
Heedzanthoy, nu Goofa heeran xeelliyaa wode saro medho oosoy beni wodepe 
doommidi de7iyaa heeratan medhettiyaa metota gade cimati giigisoninne maara 
oyson gam77idosona. Hesadankka hachchi gaso bayrata oosoy yeletape yeletakko 
aadhdhishe yidayssi lo77o meeze. Aybis giikko, asaa gaathan sarotetha dhayon daro 
asati meto bolla wodhethan buzo gidin cugan danon gelidi shemppo hayqqana gaso 
un77ettidosona. Ha metoy dere asaa wogaan gade cima shiishon gaasuwaa pooqqi 
beson xilloynne balay awsseeko geeshshidi nam77u baggata sigison gita ufayssa 
oosoy oosettees. Gujjidikka, issi derey hara deriyaara woy issi asi hara asara duussan 
dom77ey medhettiyyabaa gidikko medhettida metuwa deexuwaa mela gade cima 
dooridi giigisana mela oosettees. He ooso polanaw asay shiiqiya bessati de7oosona. 
Hessatikka, qaa7en, dubbushan, giyan, dagon, woosa keethaninne h.h.mela bessata 
shiiqidi giigisoosona. He cimati he nam77u morkkettida baggata shiishon issoy pa 
metuwaa kayan kayan paatti odana mela udon si7idaape guye suure pirdda imon 
shaakkoosona. Hessape guye, dosin ixxin “Cimi shi7a muzees” giya tossiyaa mela

10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
pantta shemppuwaape tuma pirdda imon balida uraa woy cugaa baggaa zoridinne 
seeridi aadhdhoosona. Hessa gishos nu Goofa dere asay daro wode higge soo 
baanaape sinthe ha wogaan polanaw daro dosoosona.
Kuushshan, ha adarssoy dondzata gade wogan saro medho Tophphiyaan woy gade 
dethaan, Dugeha Tophphpiyaan woy nu kililiyaaninne nu dere Goofan oosettida 
oosota shiishi oykkis. Ha oosoti dumma dumma heeratan dumma dumma ogeninne

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 1. Dabddaabbe Xaafo Maara (Personal & Official Letter Writing, 6.D Xaafo, pp. 52–59): (a) Buzo dabddaabbe (Personal letter: sender address, date, greeting 'Ta siiqo...', body [Gelo, Gomppa, Kuushshi], sign-off, recipient address) with full model letters on pp. 53 & 55; (b) Ooso dabddaabbe & Ooso koshsha dabddaabbe (Official & Job Application Letters, pp. 56–59) with reference number (Paydo), date (Gaagla), subject line (Yohoy), stamp (Maateme), and CC ( Garssa/Gakko).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 1። ደብድደአብቤ ጠአፎ መአረ (ፔርሶነል & ኦፍፊጪአል ሌትቴር ውሪቲንግ፣ 6።ድ ጠአፎ፣ ፕፕ። 52–59)፦ (አ) ቡዞ ደብድደአብቤ (ፔርሶነል ሌትቴር፦ ሴንዴር አድድሬስስ፣ ደቴ፣ ግሬእቲንግ 'ተ ሲኢቆ።።።'፣ ቦድይ [ጌሎ፣ ጎምፕፐ፣ ኩኡሽሺ]፣ ሲግን-ኦፍፍ፣ ሬጪፒእንት አድድሬስስ) ዊꬅ ፉልል ሞዴል ሌትቴርስ ኦን ፕፕ። 53 & 55፤ (ብ) ኦኦሶ ደብድደአብቤ & ኦኦሶ ኮሽሻ ደብድደአብቤ (ኦፍፊጪአል & ጆብ አፕፕሊጨቲኦን ሌትቴርስ፣ ፕፕ። 56–59) ዊꬅ ሬፌሬንጬ ኑምቤር (ፐይዶ)፣ ደቴ (ገአግለ)፣ ሱብጄጭት ሊኔ (ዮሆይ)፣ ስተምፕ (መአቴሜ)፣ አንድ ጭጭ ( ገርስሰ/ገክኮ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 1. የደብዳቤ አጻጻፍ ሥርዓት (6.D Xaafo፣ ገጽ 52–59)፦ (ሀ) የግል ደብዳቤ (Buzo dabddaabbe) አካላትና የናሙና ደብዳቤዎች፤ (ለ) የመሥሪያ ቤትና የሥራ ማመልከቻ ደብዳቤ (Ooso dabddaabbe) አካላት (ቁጥር፣ ቀን፣ ጉዳዩ፣ ማኅተም፣ ግልባጭ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 1. Formal and Personal Letter Writing Conventions in Gofatho (6.D Xaafo, pp. 52–59): Complete templates and authentic sample letters (e.g., letter to 'Goofa Zoone Timirtte Beero, Sawla' on p. 58).

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 2. Pinniyaa Peesho (Transitive Verbs) vs. Pinnonna Peesho (Intransitive Verbs) (6.F Qawosa, pp. 60–61): Pinniyaa peesho transfers action from Yohaadde (Subject) to Kaalodde (Object): 'Gawariyaa eceriwu wodhasu' ('The cat killed the mouse'); 'Ta na7aawu kathaa ma' ('My child, eat the food'). Pinnonna peesho has no direct object: 'Nuuni Sawlan de7oos' ('We live in Sawla'); 'Awi dolohara keyees' ('The sun rises in the east'); 'Tami eexxees' ('The fire burns'). Ambivalent verbs (e.g., 'so77is' / 'feared').
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 2። ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾ (ትረንሲቲቬ ቬርብስ) ቭስ። ፒንኖንነ ፔእሾ (ኢንትረንሲቲቬ ቬርብስ) (6።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕፕ። 60–61)፦ ፒንኒየአ ፔእሾ ትረንስፌርስ አጭቲኦን ፍሮም ዮሀአድዴ (ሱብጄጭት) ቶ ከአሎድዴ (ኦብጄጭት)፦ 'ገወሪየአ እጬሪዉ ዎꬋሱ' ('ꬄ ጨት ኪልሌድ ꬄ ሞኡሴ')፤ 'ተ ነዓአዉ ከꬃአ መ' ('ምይ ቺልድ፣ እአት ꬄ ፎኦድ')። ፒንኖንነ ፔእሾ ሀስ ኖ ዲሬጭት ኦብጄጭት፦ 'ኑኡኒ ሰውለን ዴዖኦስ' ('ዌ ሊቬ ኢን ሰውለ')፤ 'አዊ ዶሎሀረ ኬዬእስ' ('ꬄ ሱን ሪሴስ ኢን ꬄ እአስት')፤ 'ተሚ እእጥጤእስ' ('ꬄ ፊሬ ቡርንስ')። አምቢቨሌንት ቬርብስ (እ።ግ።፣ 'ሶዕዒስ' / 'ፌአሬድ')።

 7.1. Medh-darsso
Medh-darssoy (fiction) Adarssanchay pa kahape medhdhi kessidi shiishiya xuufe. 
Medhdhi kessees gishin biitta bolla baynnabaa medhdhees guussi gidenna. Kase 
de7iya tumaa ekkidi malayi shiloyidi shiisheesippe attin. Biitta bolla de7iyabaan 
oorathabay baynnayssi geeshshi. Asi gidin asa yuushuwan de7iyabaa ubbay binipe 
de7ees. Hano shin nuuni akeeki wuda wothidi xeelli erokko. Asdarssanchi pa de7iya 
imotaan he medhape de7iya medhetata mala immidi, tilidi, shiloyidi, asi suuketana 
mela udidi xaafiya wode ooraxxi kichees. Medhdhi kessees guussay hayssa. 
Medh-darssoy gita woy adussa medh-darsso (novel), qantha medh-darsso (short 
story), diraamanne ginxxo shiishi oykkees. Daro bagga medh-darssoti yedan 
(narritve) xaafettoosona. Mallas: adussanne qantha medh-darsso. Ginxoynne 
diraami ginxxon xaafettoosona; shin diraami ubba wode ginxxon xaafettees guussi 
gidenna. Yedan xaafettida diraami kumi attis.

58
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
 7.2.  Adussa Medh-darsso /prose fiction
Sunthay qonccisiya mela yeson dalgga, medhon adussenne aaho. Issi adussa 
medh-darssoy pana dandda7ida issi gita maxaafe gidanaw dandda7ees. Hessa 
gisho unddenna sinthinne issi ishatamu sha77u gaso oykkiya qaalan xaafettanaw 
dandda7ees. Medhon dalgga gidida gisho pa gaathan oykkiya yarati, odaawati, 
besodeti tekniketi dalggoosona. Issi gaasoy issuwara gahettishe, sikettishe, 
qashettishe, tukkettishe biya gisho qanthay daro dalggisees. Qanthay dalggi 
dalggi bishin taarikey dalggees. Taarikiya dalggatethaape denddidayssan issi uten 
(shemppo saaten) nabbabin wurenna. Odaawati tirppa gidiya gisho ayfenne (bertte) 
odaawinne sima gidida qoodan daro odaawati beettoosona. He odaawata kaallidi 
bertte issi ayfeynne tashe ayfeti de7anaw dandda7ees.
 7.2.1. Qantha Medh-darsso (short story)
Qantha medh-darssoy adussa medh-darssora gathi xeellishin medhettin wodey mata.

Tamaare Maxaafe
Meeze 1
I. Kaallidi Shiiqida Oyshota Worddo Woy Tuma Gidi Zaarite. 
1. Adarssanchay medh-darsso pa kahape medhdhi kessees gishin biitta bolla 
baynnabaa shiishees.
2. Medh-darssoy kase de7iyabaa shiloyidi shiishees.
3. De7i-darssoy dola medheta beettiya mela sinthe xaafees. 
4. Diraami ubba wode ginxxon xaafettees.
5. Gita medh-darssoy ubba wode yedan xaafettees. 
 7.3. 7.3 Adussa Medh-Darsso (Novel), Yarata 
Medh-darsso yarati adarsso xaafanaw maaddiya shalota. Oona gida adarsson 
de7anaw bessiya, adarsanchatikka go7ettanaw bessiya shiisho ogenne medhdhanaw 
maaddiya tuussi. Yaratinne hiillati medh-darsso oosoy ay malanikka shiiqo, ay 
yohokka dentho, ay keenakka dalggo woy xuummo wogara ekettanaw bessees. 
Oosuwa gurzzatethay, adarssanchaa eray, nabbabanchaa aloy yigettey he kochatana.
Yaratanne hiillata go7etetha wogay adarssuwa kochaada, mixiyaadanne hiillaada 
dummatikkoka adarsso ubbaa giddon dhayokkona. Ubbarakka bor-nashaaddeti 
adarsso oosota yigganaw xapho gidida mixeda eketteykka he yaratanne hiillata.
Ha qofaa wozanthanaw/naannisanaw ane issi malla ekkoos. Issi asi lo77o wode 
keethe keexxanaw dosin ixxin koshshiya miisheti: besse, shuchi, shafe, goda (mithi), 
qorqqoro, simintto, mismmaare, bilookete, haathenne h.h.m. adussa medh-darsso 
yarata xeellishin:
Taarike (story)
Taarikey ooso sinth-guye. Ooso ubbay issi toho ellesidi polettenna. Woden, bessan, 
hanotan pantta maara oykkidi polettoosona. Taarikey goggiya shaafa haatha mela 
duge bees. Awuppe denddidi aw gakkii giya oyshuwa zaarees. Hanikkonne “ays?” 
“waanidi?” giya gaasonne demota zaarenna.
Taarike eranaw ayfe odaawaa kaallidi buussi koshshees. “Ebeloy” koyro yaanis; 
kaallidi yaanis; hessape yaanis; wurssethan yaani shemppis guussa kanche. Issi 
nabbabida medh-darsso hara nabbabonna lagges bollara bollara odiyabaa gidikko 
taarike odoos; woy haysoos guussi.

60
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Meqethi (yangge/ plot)
Hayssi ooso sinth- guyey gaasoninne demon tukettidi sinthe buussi bessees. Meqethi 
(yanggey) oosoy polettida gaaso bessishe sinthe kolxxees. “Koyro? Kaallidi? 
Iyaappe? Wurssethanishee?’ guussa kanche gidenna “Ays yaanidee? Waanidi 
hanidee? Oonee udiday?...” gishe gaasota oychees. Oychishekka wurssetha gaso 
bees.
Odaawa (character)
Odaawati adarsso giddon adarssanchay medhdhi kessidi wothida asata. Adarsson 
dumma dumma malanne kanddo, hessadan asho ma77idi imettida pantta ooso gisho 
poliya kare (biitta bolla) de7iya asaa eqqaaddeta. 
Meeze 2
II. Kaallidi shiiqida oyshota xaafidi zaariye.
1. Medh- darsson taarikenne meqetha dummatethaa paattite.
2. Medh-darsso yaratinne tekniketi medh-darsson attonna koshshiya gaasoy 
aybee? Ane hayssas giiga malla immite.
3. Odaawa qommota odite.
Dom77e (confilict)
Dom77ey nam77u zokkottiya asata, qofata giddon medhettiya ixotethi, walasse, 
palama, bute woy ooshshi. Nam77ata giddon qofan, koshshan, medhon, kanddon, 
ammanon…, wolira sigatetha dhayon medhettees. Hessikka asa duussan metoy, 
waayey, ixoy, kachi, ooshshi, palami, xiiney morkkey, am77usey… de7eyssa 
bessees. Asay duussi luulisanaw, tumatethi demmanaw, koyidabaa polaanaw 
woxxishin dhubey dhayi erenna. He dhubeta denthanaw woy dhubetape attanaw 
dafettees, butetees, baaxetees; dom77ettees. Yaanidikka haahe gi erenna. Hara 
lo77obaas gurgguxees; xinggimaallees. Hessankka hara dhubera gahettees. 
Medh- darssoy tuma asaa duussi bessiyabaa gidida gisho, asa na7appe shaaketti 
eronna dhubetanne paaceta odaawata baggara bessees. Medh-darsson dom77e 
guussaykka hessata mela metota buuri holidi keyanaw maaddiya bute guussi.
Dom77es gaasoy daro. Asi paara, asi hara asaranne lakkaytuwaara, asi medhetara 
dom77ettees. He dom77e gaasoti asa bolla (ashon) issi naaqo/meto gathees. Woy

61
Tamaare Maxaafe
kaha bolla naaqo/meto gathidi paacci be7ees. Adarssanchay he naaqota asa bolla 
be7idi medhdhi kessida odaawata bolla wothees. Odawaati he metuwappe keyanaw 
butetiya butey, dafetethay adarssuwaas mala immees. Nabbabanchaa wozanaa 
sottidi sinthe woxisees. Meqethan taarikey gasoranne demora tukettidi medhettiya 
tanggoy gaaso gidishin he gaasoykka dom77e gidees. Nam77u dom77e kochchati:
Asho Dom77e (physical confilict)
Hayssi issi odaaway hara odaawara ashon woy asatethan medhdhiya dom77etethi, 
bute, gorppetethi. Ha butiyaan kunddetha, wadhetetha, oletetha, shooletetha mela 
asho bolla gakkiya metota be7oos. Hayssi kare bolla (asatetha) woy asho dom77e 
geetettees. Hessi asa na7a bolla tumappe gakkiya meto gididayssa doganaw bessenna.
Kaha Dom77e (psychological confilict)
Issi odaaway issibay iya bolla gathiya naaquwaape denddidi pa ulo, wozana, kaha 
gaathan meetettiya hanota (gaatha qofa).

ዴምሜእስ።

ኦዴንነ። ከአስሰንቻተ ቀአጡወ ከሬን ኡትቲ ጤእልሊሼ አአꬄእስ። ኢስሲ አደርስሰንቺ ሀ 
ሀአስጊነአ ኦይድዱ ሀአስጊነ ጎዔትቲዲ ሺሼእስ።

እረአወ ዎይ ኡብበአ ዉርስሲ እሬእስ ጉኡስሲ። ሀይስሰ ጌእቴትቲደይ ሀይሰድዴይ ከሬን ኡትቲዲ 
ኦደአወቲ ሀኒየአበ ኡብበአ ጤእልሊሼ ኦዲየ ጊሾስሰ። ኦደአወ ኢስሶይ ኢስሶይ ሀኒየአበአ

በአወ። ሀይስሰ ሜለ ጊነይ አደርስሰንቻይ ኦደአወተ ጉዬን ጌእምሚዲ ፐ ገአꬃ 
ቆፈአ ነብበበንቻተስ ቆንጭጪሲ ኦደነው መአድዴእስ። ነብበበንቻቲ አደርስሱወአፔ 
ሀአክኮኦሶነ።

ሀይስሰ ሜለ ሀአስጊነን ጠፌትቲደ አደርስሶን ሀይሰአድዴይ ፐ ሁኡጴረ ተአሪኪየ ጊድዶ

“ኑኡኒ የአኒደ፤ኑኡኒ የአቲደ…፣ ጊሼ ኦዴእስ። ሀይሰአድዴይ ቀአጦን (ኦኦሶን) ጌሊዲ 
ኩሼትቲሼ ኦዲየ ጊሾ ነብበበንቻቲ ተአሪኪየ መተን ከአልሎኦሶነ።

ቆፈ ጤእልሎኦስ።
“…ሀ ተአሪኪየ ሂንትቴስ ጠአፊየ ተአኒ ሀይቅቀደ ዶጌትቲደ አሴ። አሲ-ዴሬይ እሪን 
ሞኦጌትተስ። ሂንትቴ ተ ሱንꬃአ ዴንꬂዲ ተ ለክከይቱወአፔ ኢስሲ አሴ ኦይቺየአኮ “1884 
ኔፒልሴን ዴንድዲደ ኮሌእረ ገዶይ ሀርቅቂደ አሰተፔ ኢስሱወ፤ ተ አሀይክከ ሀዕዒ ዱኡፎን

8.1.1 Palantho adarsso
Ha adarssouwaa sunthay qoncisiya mela palantho adarsoy issi allalle haraara gathi

Muussinne Ushshi
“Miday bidaa gakkees” gees Goofatho tossey. Hekko ‘uyiday bidaa gakkees’ gishin 
si7i ereetii? Yaatikko, ushshi gishin xillo xoossa haathi, woy nu dere irko maathi 
gidonna shin uyi ekkin haa uyaa mathoyiya wolqaama ushshi gaanaassa. ‘Gede min 
haa miya bambariyaw, Gede uyin haa uyaa haraqiyaw’ giya bini yetha sabaa qopite. 
Muussi gidin ushshi go77anaas woy qohanaas danda7ees. Shin, ubbaape, alepe aathi 
ushshi ubba wode qoheesepe attin go77enna. 
Qumi asa na7as shempo. Qumape haakkidi waani de7anee? Ane akeekite. Nu seeley 
wonta omarsi quma koyees. Nu diccey, nu paammey, nu cil7ey, nu uusattey quma 
mishina. Nu wolqa abbe demmey, nu iita hargepe naagettey, nu bollaa kooley, nu 
wolqaama gita ooso oothey quma mishina. Nu ifilay kumin oothishin aggopa aggopa 
gees; kaa7ishin bollas lo77ees; hamettishin woxxa woxxa gees. Lagge dabbora 
uttidi issibaa nashshanaw, iita shin hayqqin afuxxidi yeekkanaw, haray attin, uloy 
kallanaw bessees. 
Muussi wolqanne wolqa malanne mala. Bini nuukkon issi uray ‘wolqi ulona’ gees. 
“Ma ekkada cil7aasa; ciiyaasa. Tista ekkada elcaasape attin ciiyakka. Ne bolla 
gogaape attin gaathay tistin ciiyenna’ gees. Hayssi tumape tuma.

hessada baaloyana gaana. Shin , ane ushshinne ushshi yaariya ase akeeki xeellite. 
Koyro, kaassay, nashoy, haysey, miichay, arashay. . . lo77ees; Ubbara ufayssees. 
Haathi miiccishin mees giya tossiya mela gam7ishin, guuthara guja guja gees.

ኮኦሊን ሶኦ ጌሊደ አሰአ፣ ፐ ሲኢቆ መቺውንኔ ነይተ ሰሮተአ ꬋይስሲደ አሰአ፣ ሚኢሼ – 
ሻሎ ኡሽሻን ጢርሲ ኦንጊዲ ሜቶን ጌሊደ አሰአ፣ አአወ - አአዮ፣ ደብቦ ለግጌ ዚቅቂ ꬎቅቁ 
ኡዲ ቀአሪዲ ጨዪደ አሰአ ። ። ። ፐይዲ ዉርስሶኮ። በግገቲ መꬆይ አአꬍꬊን ዎዘነ ዘአሪዲ 
“ዪኢ ጮኦ፤ አትቲደ ጊዴእሬንኔ” ጎኦሶነ። ገንጄይ ሙልሉጊን፣ ቲሬይ ኪጥጢን፣ መረአጬይ 
ጠአመቲን ሀይቅቂ ዱኡፎ ጌሊደ አሰአ ቆኦደይክከ ኡንድዴንነ። ሀልሊꬃይ ኩንዲሲ አግጊን 
ሀንኒረ አአꬍꬊደ ጊደአርኪነ ጊን አይ መአድዲኢ? 
ሀ ኡብበይ ቱመ። ኢ ሙኡስሲክከ ዎገረ ሎዕዖ። ኡሎይ ከልሊን ፒሊ ጨምሜእስ ጊየ ቶስሴይ 
ጮኦ ሜለ ቶስሴትቲቤእንነ። “የአሬ ሙኡስሲ ቢኒ ቀአልሊስ ኡሎ ደአክክኪስ” ጌእስ። 
አሰንከ ቆሮንነ ሙኡስሲ ሀንደ ጨዲሲዲ ሞኦልሎ እሂዲ ቦልለ መለአ ኢኢስሴእስ፤ አሾ 
ዴእጤꬄእስ። ኡሽሻ ደሮይክከ ኢየ ሜለ። ቢኒ ሉጢደ እረንቻቲ የአጎኦስነ። “ሚኢቺ 
ደሪሼ አፉꬄእስ። ኢንጅጄቴꬂ ደሪሼክከ ሄስሰደ ቆሄእስ። ኡብበበአ ቤስሲየ ሜለ 
ኦይክኪክኮ ሎዕዖይ አትቶሺን ኢኢተይክከ ጎዕዔእስ” ጊየ ቤርትቴ ኦደአ ኦኦሶ ቦልለ ፔእሽሺደይ 
ጎዔትቴሴፔ አትቲን ቆሄትቴንነ። (ይ።ዝ።ኡርገአሞ - 2009)
ሜእዜ 4
ኢ። ከአልሊዲ ኢሜትቲደ ከአረተን ፐለንꬂየአ አደርስሶ ጠአፊቴ።
1። ዴሪየ ገሴꬂየ ሚኢሼ (ሶጪአል ሜዲእአ) ጎዔቴꬃአ ወልሎቴꬃይ ከሴ ሀይስሰፔ 
ሎዖ።
2። ዴሬይ መርክከንድዶ እእሶን ለአሜሬትተነው ዎይ ዴምመነውንኔ ኢስሲፔቴꬂ 
ሜꬍꬋነው ሀዒ ዎዴይስሰፔ ቤኒ ዎዴ መአርክከንድዶ ፑልትቶቲ ሎዖቴꬃን 
አአꬍꬌእስ።

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Dumma dumma dere miidiyaa qommoti de7ishin hessatape nam77atanne bertteti: deriyaa barbaxiyaa bessata (social networking sites: Peesibuuke, Telegiraame) nne kesota woy biidota laamerettiyaa bessata (content/video sites: Yuutuube).
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ዱምመ ዱምመ ዴሬ ሚኢዲየአ ቆምሞቲ ዴዒሺን ሄስሰተፔ ነምዕዓተንኔ ቤርትቴቲ፦ ዴሪየአ በርበጢየአ ቤስሰተ (ሶጪአል ኔትዎርኪንግ ሲቴስ፦ ፔእሲቡኡኬ፣ ቴሌጊረአሜ) ንኔ ኬሶተ ዎይ ቢኢዶተ ለአሜሬትቲየአ ቤስሰተ (ጮንቴንት/ቪዴኦ ሲቴስ፦ ዩኡቱኡቤ)።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: ከተለያዩ የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ዓይነቶች መካከል ሁለቱ ዋና ዋናዎቹ፦ ማኅበረሰብን የሚያስተሳስሩ ድረ-ገጾች (ፌስቡክ፣ ቴሌግራም) እና ምስልና ድምፅ (ቪዲዮ) የሚለዋወጡባቸው ድረ-ገጾች (ዩቲዩብ) ናቸው።
key_aligned_sentences.english: Two major categories of social media are social networking sites (deriyaa barbaxiyaa bessata, e.g., Facebook, Telegram) and audio-visual content-sharing sites (e.g., YouTube).

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Muussinne Ushshi (Palantho Adarsso, pp. 77–78): 'Miday bidaa gakkees' gees Goofatho tossey... 'Uloy kallin pili cammees' giya tossey coo mela tossettibeenna; 'Yaare muussi bini qaallis ulo daakkis' gees.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ሙኡስሲንኔ ኡሽሺ (ፐለንꬆ አደርስሶ፣ ፕፕ። ዕዕ–78)፦ 'ሚደይ ቢደአ ገክኬእስ' ጌእስ ጎኦፈꬆ ቶስሴይ።።። 'ኡሎይ ከልሊን ፒሊ ጨምሜእስ' ጊየ ቶስሴይ ጮኦ ሜለ ቶስሴትቲቤእንነ፤ 'የአሬ ሙኡስሲ ቢኒ ቀአልሊስ ኡሎ ደአክኪስ' ጌእስ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: 'ምግብና መጠጥ' (አከራካሪ ድርሰት፣ ገጽ 77–78)፦ 'የበላ የሄደውን ይደርሳል' ይላል የጎፋኛ ምሳሌ... 'ሆድ ሲጠግብ አንጎል (ቅልጥም) ይመራል' የሚለው ምሳሌ በከንቱ አልተነገረም።
key_aligned_sentences.english: From the model argumentative essay 'Food and Drink' (pp. 77–78): Contrasts the dangers of excessive alcohol and gluttony using classic Gofatho proverbs.

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (8.B Haasaya Palama, p. 74): Four classroom debates: 1. Telebizhine vs. Iraadoone; 2. Moobayle vs. Soo silkke (Mobile phone vs. landline); 3. Postta vs. Imeele (Postal mail vs. Email); 4. Beni wode miidiya vs. Ha77i wode miidiya.
haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (8።ብ ሀአሰየ ፐለመ፣ ፕ። 74)፦ ፎኡር ጭለስስሮኦም ዴበቴስ፦ 1። ቴሌቢዢኔ ቭስ። ኢረአዶኦኔ፤ 2። ሞኦበይሌ ቭስ። ሶኦ ሲልክኬ (ሞቢሌ ፆኔ ቭስ። ለንድሊኔ)፤ 3። ፖስትተ ቭስ። ኢሜእሌ (ፖስተል መኢል ቭስ። እመኢል)፤ 4። ቤኒ ዎዴ ሚኢዲየ ቭስ። ሀዕዒ ዎዴ ሚኢዲየ።
haasaya_dialogues.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (8.B የክርክር ርዕሶች፣ ገጽ 74)፦ 1. ቴሌቪዥንና ሬዲዮ፤ 2. ሞባይል ስልክና የቤት ስልክ፤ 3. ፖስታና ኢሜይል፤ 4. የድሮና የዘመኑ ሚዲያ።
haasaya_dialogues.english: Exercise 2 (8.B Structured Debates, p. 74): Debate Television vs. Radio, Mobile Phone vs. Landline, Postal Mail vs. Email, and Traditional vs. Modern Media.

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 1. Adarso Qommota (4 Essay Types, 8.D Xaafo, p. 76): (1) Paatetha Adarso (Narrative essay), (2) Qonciso Adarso (Descriptive essay), (3) Qaari beso Adarso (Expository essay), (4) Palantho Adarso (Argumentative essay).
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 1። አደርሶ ቆምሞተ (4 እስሰይ ትይፔስ፣ 8።ድ ጠአፎ፣ ፕ። 76)፦ (1) ፐአቴꬃ አደርሶ (ነርረቲቬ እስሰይ)፣ (2) ቆንጪሶ አደርሶ (ዴስጭሪፕቲቬ እስሰይ)፣ (3) ቀአሪ ቤሶ አደርሶ (እጥፖሲቶርይ እስሰይ)፣ (4) ፐለንꬆ አደርሶ (አርጉሜንተቲቬ እስሰይ)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 1. አራቱ የድርሰት ዓይነቶች (8.D Xaafo፣ ገጽ 76)፦ (1) ተራኪ ድርሰት (Paatetha)፣ (2) ሥዕላዊ/ገላጭ ድርሰት (Qonciso)፣ (3) አብራሪ ድርሰት (Qaari beso)፣ (4) አመዛዛኝ/አከራካሪ ድርሰት (Palantho)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 1. Four Essay Genres (8.D Xaafo, p. 76): Narrative (Paatetha), Descriptive (Qonciso), Expository (Qaari beso), and Argumentative (Palantho).

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: 2. Wode Bessiya Peeshota (3 Verb Tenses, 8.F Qawosa, pp. 79–80): (1) Aadhode (Past: Si7is, Mis, Xaafis, Nabbabasu, Haasayis — Malla: 'Na7ay qumaa mis. Na7iyaa soo oosuwaa oothasu.'); (2) Ha7ode (Present: Si7ees, Mees, Xaafees, Nabbabaawusu, Haasayees — Malla: 'Orzaama miidiyaa kiitata nabbabaawusu.'); (3) Sinthode (Future: Si7ana, Maana, Xaafana, Nabbabana, Haasayana — Malla: 'Nuuni soo oosuwaa dogonna mela akeekana.').
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: 2። ዎዴ ቤስሲየ ፔእሾተ (3 ቬርብ ቴንሴስ፣ 8።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕፕ። 79–80)፦ (1) አአꬎዴ (ፐስት፦ ሲዒስ፣ ሚስ፣ ጠአፊስ፣ ነብበበሱ፣ ሀአሰዪስ — መልለ፦ 'ነዓይ ቁመአ ሚስ። ነዒየአ ሶኦ ኦኦሱወአ ኦኦꬃሱ።')፤ (2) ሀዖዴ (ፕሬሴንት፦ ሲዔእስ፣ ሜእስ፣ ጠአፌእስ፣ ነብበበአዉሱ፣ ሀአሰዬእስ — መልለ፦ 'ኦርዘአመ ሚኢዲየአ ኪኢተተ ነብበበአዉሱ።')፤ (3) ሲንꬆዴ (ፉቱሬ፦ ሲዓነ፣ መአነ፣ ጠአፈነ፣ ነብበበነ፣ ሀአሰየነ — መልለ፦ 'ኑኡኒ ሶኦ ኦኦሱወአ ዶጎንነ ሜለ አኬእከነ።')።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: 2. ጊዜ አመልካች ግሶች (8.F Qawosa፣ ገጽ 79–80)፦ (1) ኃላፊ ጊዜ (Aadhode፦ mis, oothasu)፤ (2) የአሁን ጊዜ (Ha7ode፦ mees, nabbabaawusu)፤ (3) የወደፊት ጊዜ (Sinthode፦ maana, akeekana)።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: 2. Tense-Aspect Verbal Paradigms (8.F Qawosa, pp. 79–80): Complete conjugation of Si7- ('hear'), M- ('eat'), Xaaf- ('write'), Nabbab- ('read'), and Haasay- ('speak') across Past (Aadhode), Present (Ha7ode), and Future (Sinthode).

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: የበላ የሄደውን ይደርሳል (ምግብ የበላ ሰው ብርታት ያገኛል)።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: He who has eaten catches up with the one who has already set out.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ውኃ እየሳቀ ይበላል (ይወስዳል)።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Water devours while smiling (calm appearances can hide danger, like alcohol).

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: ሆድ ሲጠግብ ቅልጥም ይመራል።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: When the stomach is full, even bone marrow tastes bitter.

leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_latin: Yaare muussi bini qaallis ulo daakkis.
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.gofatho_fidel: የአሬ ሙኡስሲ ቢኒ ቀአልሊስ ኡሎ ደአክኪስ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.amharic: የስስት (የድግስ) መብል ጥንትም የቃሊስን ሆድ ቀደደ።
leemiso_proverbs_idioms_oral_lit.english: Greedy overeating tore open Qaallis's stomach even in olden times.

key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_latin: Nu gade Goofa asay tossishe, 'Uttiday dulle pittees, qaaxxiday qanthe pittees' geyssa mela medhdhi oosoy bonchchisees, asaara erisees, dureyees.
key_aligned_sentences.gofatho_fidel: ኑ ገዴ ጎኦፈ አሰይ ቶስሲሼ፣ 'ኡትቲደይ ዱልሌ ፒትቴእስ፣ ቀአጥጢደይ ቀንꬄ ፒትቴእስ' ጌይስሰ ሜለ ሜꬍꬊ ኦኦሶይ ቦንችቺሴእስ፣ አሰአረ እሪሴእስ፣ ዱሬዬእስ።
key_aligned_sentences.amharic: የአገራችን የጎፋ ሕዝብ 'የተቀመጠ መቀመጫውን ያራግፋል፣ የተንቀሳቀሰ ግን ቅቤ ይቀባል (ይበለጽጋል)' ብሎ እንደሚተርተው ሥራ ፈጠራ ያስከብራል፣ ከሰው ጋር ያስተዋውቃል፣ ያበለጽጋል።
key_aligned_sentences.english: As the Gofatho proverb says, 'He who sits brushes dust off his seat, while he who moves and works prospers,' entrepreneurship brings honor, connection, and wealth.

haasaya_dialogues.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (9።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 82)፦ ፐኢር አንድ ግሮኡፕ ዲስጩስሲኦን ኦን 6 ቁእስቲኦንስ፦ 1። ኢስሲ አሲ ወአኒ ዱሬተነው ደንድደዒየአክኮ ቶብቢቴ። 2። ዎዴ ሱኡሬን ጎዔቴꬃረንኔ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎረ ወአኒ ገሄትቲየአኮ ሀአሰዪቴ። 6። ተመአሪ ዉርስሲዲ ከዎ ኦኦሶ ኦኦꬂኮ ሎዖኦዬ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬊ ኦኦꬂኮ ሎዖኦ?

qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_latin: Os-meqonne Ost-meqo (Active Voice and Passive Voice, 9.F Qawosa, pp. 86–87, cited from Beddilu Wozza 2014): In Os-meqo (Active), the agent subject (Yohaadde) performs the action: 'Wozaakkoy keethe keexxis' ('Wozaakko built a house'); 'Bunnaaroy muuze tokkis' ('Bunnaaro planted a banana tree'). In Ost-meqo (Passive), the object (Kaalodde) takes nominative '-y', the agent optionally takes instrumental/locative '-n' or ablative '-ppe', and the verb takes passive '-ett-': (1) 'Muuzey Bunnaaron tokettis' or 'Muuzey Bunnaaroppe tokettis' ('The banana tree was planted by Bunnaaro'); (2) Agentless passive: 'Muuzey tokettis' ('The banana tree was planted').
qawosa_grammar_rules.gofatho_fidel: ኦስ-ሜቆንኔ ኦስት-ሜቆ (አጭቲቬ ቮኢጬ አንድ ፐስሲቬ ቮኢጬ፣ 9።ፍ ቀዎሰ፣ ፕፕ። 86–87፣ ጪቴድ ፍሮም ቤድዲሉ ዎዝዘ 2014)፦ ኢን ኦስ-ሜቆ (አጭቲቬ)፣ ꬄ አጌንት ሱብጄጭት (ዮሀአድዴ) ፔርፎርምስ ꬄ አጭቲኦን፦ 'ዎዘአክኮይ ኬእꬄ ኬእጥጢስ' ('ዎዘአክኮ ቡኢልት አ ሆኡሴ')፤ 'ቡንነአሮይ ሙኡዜ ቶክኪስ' ('ቡንነአሮ ፕለንቴድ አ በነነ ትሬእ')። ኢን ኦስት-ሜቆ (ፐስሲቬ)፣ ꬄ ኦብጄጭት (ከአሎድዴ) ተኬስ ኖሚነቲቬ '-ይ'፣ ꬄ አጌንት ኦፕቲኦነልልይ ተኬስ ኢንስትሩሜንተል/ሎጨቲቬ '-ን' ኦር አብለቲቬ '-ፕፔ'፣ አንድ ꬄ ቬርብ ተኬስ ፐስሲቬ '-እትት-'፦ (1) 'ሙኡዜይ ቡንነአሮን ቶኬትቲስ' ኦር 'ሙኡዜይ ቡንነአሮፕፔ ቶኬትቲስ' ('ꬄ በነነ ትሬእ ወስ ፕለንቴድ ብይ ቡንነአሮ')፤ (2) አጌንትሌስስ ፐስሲቬ፦ 'ሙኡዜይ ቶኬትቲስ' ('ꬄ በነነ ትሬእ ወስ ፕለንቴድ')።
qawosa_grammar_rules.amharic: የድርጊት (Os-meqo) እና የተደራጊ (Ost-meqo) ዓረፍተ ነገሮች (9.F Qawosa፣ ገጽ 86–87)፦ በድርጊት ዓ.ነገር፦ 'ቡናሮ ሙዝ ተከለ (Bunnaaroy muuze tokkis)'። ወደ ተደራጊ ሲቀየር፦ (1) 'ሙዙ በቡናሮ ተተከለ (Muuzey Bunnaaron/Bunnaaroppe tokettis)' ወይም (2) 'ሙዙ ተተከለ (Muuzey tokettis)'።
qawosa_grammar_rules.english: Active Voice (Os-meqo) and Passive Voice (Ost-meqo) Derivations (9.F Qawosa, pp. 86–87): Formalizes agentive passive ('-n' / '-ppe' on demoted agent + '-ett-' on verb) and agentless passive ('Muuzey tokettis').
